Vector Redirect.description: Seize and redirect an incoming force's vector through controlled gravitational adjustment, turning momentum against its source. Requires sustained contact with the local field and fails if the source force exceeds the user's practiced threshold.

Orbital Sweep.name: Orbital Sweep
Orbital Sweep.description: Sustain and steer an orbital trajectory through multiple objects or targets in sequence, bending the arc in real time to bypass obstacles. Control degrades with distance and competing fields.

Anchor Field.name: Anchor Field
Anchor Field.description: Lock a wider area against displacement, preventing forced movement of objects and persons within the anchored zone. Strength scales with concentration; sufficiently violent force can shatter the anchor.

Density Surge.name: Density Surge
Density Surge.description: Sharply increase personal density on command, becoming harder to move and amplifying ground-contact impact delivery. Duration is short and controlled; releasing too fast risks disorientation.

Inertia Drain.name: Inertia Drain
Inertia Drain.description: Bleed momentum from a fast-moving object or person over a wider contact area, decelerating projectiles and charges. Cannot stop anything instantaneously; the faster it moves, the more it costs.

Dispersal Wave.name: Dispersal Wave
Dispersal Wave.description: Absorb a major impact and redirect the stored force outward as a controlled dispersal, clearing immediate threats from contact range. The user absorbs real strain; repeated use in succession is dangerous.

Kinetic Burst.name: Kinetic Burst
Kinetic Burst.description: Store kinetic energy through sustained contact and release it in a focused burst, exceeding what untrained reinforcement achieves. Timing the release is critical; a mistimed burst dissipates harmlessly.

Barrier Shell.name: Barrier Shell
Barrier Shell.description: Project and sustain a kinetic-barrier enclosure around the user's full body, absorbing directional impacts under sustained pressure. Maintaining the shell requires continuous concentration; gaps appear if attention splits.

Directional Lock.name: Directional Lock
Directional Lock.description: Arrest all movement in a chosen direction across a target's body, immobilizing specific limbs or actions while leaving others free. The lock holds only as long as concentration does; breaking contact breaks the effect.

Shear Curtain.name: Shear Curtain
Shear Curtain.description: Sustain a pressure differential across a wider plane, creating a barrier effect that resists passage from one side. Not solid; sufficiently determined or massive force pushes through, but at cost.

Thermal Surge.name: Thermal Surge
Thermal Surge.description: Channel concentrated thermal output across a larger surface area, sustaining higher temperatures than contact-level expression achieves. Extended use drains the user; ambient materials determine how far heat travels.

Glacial Grip.name: Glacial Grip
Glacial Grip.description: Extend cryothermal expression beyond direct contact, drawing heat from surrounding materials and surfaces to create localized freezing conditions. The area affected is limited by the user's sustained output.

Gale Corridor.name: Gale Corridor
Gale Corridor.description: Direct sustained airflow through a corridor or open space, controlling wind speed and direction to impede or redirect movement within the affected lane. Open environments dissipate control faster.

Earthen Rampart.name: Earthen Rampart
Earthen Rampart.description: Raise and shape a larger stone formation from available ground, creating functional cover, barriers, or elevated positions. The material must actually be present; bare metal floors yield nothing.

Field Diversion.name: Field Diversion
Field Diversion.description: Redirect ambient or directed electromagnetic energy along a chosen path, diverting electrical output away from protected areas or toward a grounding point. Cannot create energy, only steer it.

Metal Shaping.name: Metal Shaping
Metal Shaping.description: Reshape gathered metal into functional forms under sustained concentration — temporary blades, bindings, patches, structural braces. The shape holds after release but is not permanent; it relaxes over hours.

Heat Trace.name: Heat Trace
Heat Trace.description: Map and retain thermal signatures across a wider area, tracking recent contact, movement paths, and residual body heat through walls and surfaces. Resolution drops with time elapsed since the trace was laid.

Emotional Anchor.name: Emotional Anchor
Emotional Anchor.description: Stabilize or dampen an escalating emotional state in a nearby person through sustained empathic contact, calming panic or diffusing aggression. Does not override free will; a determined mind resists.

Pain Mapping.name: Pain Mapping
Pain Mapping.description: Map the full distribution of neural stress across a body at range, identifying injuries, fatigue points, and vulnerability without physical contact. Accuracy decreases with distance and intervening barriers.

Pattern Anticipation.name: Pattern Anticipation
Pattern Anticipation.description: Project a recognized pattern forward, predicting the next likely state or movement based on observed sequence and rhythm. Novel or deliberately chaotic input defeats the projection.

Thread Network.name: Thread Network
Thread Network.description: Maintain multiple simultaneous conceptual partitions, tracking several independent lines of thought, conversation, or observation without interference. Cognitive load limits the number of threads.

Resonant Command.name: Resonant Command
Resonant Command.description: Project the voice with controlled resonance that cuts through active interference — machinery, combat noise, hostile acoustics — reaching intended targets clearly across a wide area.

Impression Chain.name: Impression Chain
Impression Chain.description: Read a sequence of residual impressions from an object, reconstructing a chain of recent handlers, environments, or significant events in order. Older impressions fade and may be incomplete.

Route Mapping.name: Route Mapping
Route Mapping.description: Perceive and hold a complete spatial map of connected routes through a complex structure, updating in real time as paths change. The map is only as accurate as what can be sensed; sealed areas remain blank.

Acoustic Sculpting.name: Acoustic Sculpting
Acoustic Sculpting.description: Shape the acoustic environment within a larger area, selectively amplifying, dampening, or redirecting sound sources. Cannot create sound from nothing; works only with what is already present.

System Diagnosis.name: System Diagnosis
System Diagnosis.description: Perceive the operational state of a complex machine in full, identifying faults, wear patterns, and imminent failures simultaneously. Works through physical contact or close proximity to active systems.

Shadow Merge.name: Shadow Merge
Shadow Merge.description: Reduce personal visibility to near-undetectable levels in low-light conditions, merging with available shadow and environmental visual noise. Movement, bright light, or direct observation breaks the effect.

Sustained Restoration.name: Sustained Restoration
Sustained Restoration.description: Maintain accelerated healing support over an extended period, stabilizing multiple injuries simultaneously through sustained biological field contact. Drains the user proportionally to the damage being addressed.

Provenance Read.name: Provenance Read
Provenance Read.description: Trace a material's complete handling history through deeper impression, identifying origin, modification, and environmental exposure across a longer timeline than surface-level readings achieve.

Structural Assessment.name: Structural Assessment
Structural Assessment.description: Perceive and map the complete stress distribution in a structure, identifying load-bearing weaknesses, failure points, and safe paths through damaged architecture.

Interface Calibration.name: Interface Calibration
Interface Calibration.description: Adapt to and operate unfamiliar mechanical or technical interfaces through direct tactile perception, bypassing the need for instruction or documentation. Complexity still limits speed.

Emergency Weld.name: Emergency Weld
Emergency Weld.description: Bond or repair a structural failure under active stress — holding a failing joint, sealing a breach, stabilizing a fracture in real time. The repair holds under the conditions it was made; it is not permanent.

Structural Sonar.name: Structural Sonar
Structural Sonar.description: Map the internal structure of a wall, floor, or machine through sustained vibration sensing, detecting voids, faults, hidden spaces, and embedded objects without breaking the surface.

Luminous Scene.name: Luminous Scene
Luminous Scene.description: Compose and sustain a larger light environment — multiple figures, ambient effects, or navigational markers across an area. Complexity is limited by concentration; the scene simplifies if attention wavers.

Solar Flare.name: Solar Flare
Solar Flare.description: Release stored stellar radiance in a focused burst, producing intense light and heat sufficient to dazzle, disorient, or ignite nearby combustibles. The burst depletes stored reserves; recovery takes time.

Crimson Torrent.name: Crimson Torrent
Crimson Torrent.description: Sustain and direct crimson energy output as a continuous flow rather than a single surge, maintaining directed pressure over an extended exchange. Output degrades with duration; the user's reserves are finite.

Mantle Expansion.name: Mantle Expansion
Mantle Expansion.description: Extend the aether mantle's protective range to cover nearby allies or a wider area, maintaining coherent defense across the expanded field. Strain increases proportionally with coverage.

Lance Barrage.name: Lance Barrage
Lance Barrage.description: Generate and direct multiple coherent lance projections in rapid succession, each independently targeted within the user's field of control. Accuracy degrades with target count.

Sustained Ascent.name: Sustained Ascent
Sustained Ascent.description: Maintain embodied flight for extended periods under load or adverse conditions, carrying additional weight or operating in turbulent fields without losing control.

Structural Conjuration.name: Structural Conjuration
Structural Conjuration.description: Create larger resonant structures on demand — bridges, barriers, platforms — sustaining them under load without continuous concentration. Structure integrity is tied to the user's reserves.

Mass Restoration.name: Mass Restoration
Mass Restoration.description: Extend restorative contact to multiple patients simultaneously, stabilizing a group of injured individuals under field conditions. Output is divided; more patients means less per person.

Domain Assertion.name: Domain Assertion
Domain Assertion.description: Expand the harmonic domain's range and intensity, enforcing environmental conditions across a wider area with greater resistance to disruption. Maintaining assertion is exhausting; duration is limited.

Severance Cascade.name: Severance Cascade
Severance Cascade.description: Break multiple active resonance patterns simultaneously, disrupting coordinated workings or layered defenses in a single action. Each additional target reduces precision on all others.

Concordant Wave.name: Concordant Wave
Concordant Wave.description: Release concordant energy as an expanding wave rather than focused contact, affecting all willing participants in range. Unwilling targets are unaffected; the wave cannot be weaponized.

Counter Stance.name: Counter Stance
Counter Stance.description: Convert a successful defensive read into an immediate counter, exploiting the gap an attacker's committed strike creates. Requires the read to be accurate; misreading leads to worse position.

Submission Hold.name: Submission Hold
Submission Hold.description: Transition from grapple control into a restraining hold that limits the opponent's options to escape, compliance, or unconsciousness. Maintaining the hold requires sustained effort and position.

Staff Sweep.name: Staff Sweep
Staff Sweep.description: Use the staff's reach to control engagement distance, sweeping legs or deflecting multiple opponents approaching from different angles in a single rotation.

Riposte.name: Riposte
Riposte.description: Convert a parried blade into an immediate return strike before the opponent recovers guard, exploiting the opening the defense created. Timing is narrow; a late riposte meets a reset guard.

Suppressive Fire.name: Suppressive Fire
Suppressive Fire.description: Maintain accurate fire that denies movement through a controlled lane, pinning targets behind cover without wasting ammunition. Requires a stable position and line of sight.

Extraction Route.name: Extraction Route
Extraction Route.description: Identify and secure an evacuation path while maintaining protective coverage, moving a charge through hostile territory. The route must actually exist; no path means no extraction.

Controlled De-escalation.name: Controlled De-escalation
Controlled De-escalation.description: Restrain an aggressive individual with minimum force while simultaneously calming the situation, preventing escalation into lethal violence. Does not work on opponents committed to killing.

Relentless Advance.name: Relentless Advance
Relentless Advance.description: Sustain forward pressure through an opponent's defense, maintaining rhythm and power across multiple exchanges without overextending. Exhaustion is real; the advance slows over time.

Fortress Stance.name: Fortress Stance
Fortress Stance.description: Anchor a defensive position that multiple attackers cannot move, absorbing coordinated pressure while protecting what stands behind. The stance holds; the person in it eventually does not.

Flowing Transition.name: Flowing Transition
Flowing Transition.description: Chain defensive and offensive blade movements into a continuous flow, adapting in real time without resetting stance between actions. Sustained flow drains stamina; pauses are earned, not free.

Closing Strike.name: Closing Strike
Closing Strike.description: Close distance explosively on a retreating opponent, arriving with a committed blade before they can reset guard. If the target does not retreat, the closing overextends into their prepared defense.

Shield Circle.name: Shield Circle
Shield Circle.description: Maintain protective coverage for multiple nearby individuals, repositioning between threats and charges as the situation develops. More charges means thinner coverage; three is practical, five is heroic.

Aerial Press.name: Aerial Press
Aerial Press.description: Use aerial position to initiate or sustain offensive pressure from above, combining flight mobility with committed striking angles that ground-bound opponents cannot easily match.

Signal Beacon.name: Signal Beacon
Signal Beacon.description: Sustain a visible signal light at distance, modulating intensity and pattern for communication or navigation under adverse conditions. Range and clarity scale with skill; ambient light competes.

Thermal Working.name: Thermal Working
Thermal Working.description: Shape and control thermal energy across a wider working area, maintaining precise temperature gradients for extended operations including forging, climate control, and hazard management.

Force Press.name: Force Press
Force Press.description: Apply sustained directional force at range, pressing or holding objects and individuals along a chosen vector. The press maintains as long as concentration does; resistance reduces its effectiveness.

Ward Array.name: Ward Array
Ward Array.description: Inscribe and maintain multiple protective wards in a coordinated array, covering a larger area with layered defense. Each additional ward in the array dilutes the strength of all others.

Containment Circle.name: Containment Circle
Containment Circle.description: Establish a full containment perimeter that resists passage, energy discharge, and working from within, holding more dangerous subjects. The circle's strength is set at inscription; it does not grow.

Field Survey.name: Field Survey
Field Survey.description: Survey an area for all active workings, residual inscriptions, and latent effects simultaneously, mapping the magical environment in full. Dense or layered effects can obscure each other.

Stasis Lock.name: Stasis Lock
Stasis Lock.description: Arrest deterioration in a larger or more unstable subject, maintaining preservation conditions beyond what a standard seal sustains. Drains the user proportionally to what is being preserved.

Regenerative Working.name: Regenerative Working
Regenerative Working.description: Sustain a healing working that actively repairs tissue rather than merely stabilizing, accelerating natural recovery under controlled conditions. Cannot replace surgery or restore what is fully destroyed.

Waypoint Network.name: Waypoint Network
Waypoint Network.description: Inscribe and maintain multiple connected route markers that guide travelers through complex or changing terrain automatically. Markers degrade over time and require periodic renewal.

Working Audit.name: Working Audit
Working Audit.description: Conduct a comprehensive assessment of an entire working or inscribed system, identifying degradation, tampering, and structural weakness across all connected elements.

Kinetic Sovereignty.name: Kinetic Sovereignty
Kinetic Sovereignty.description: Simultaneously redirect, absorb, and release kinetic force across multiple vectors in the immediate environment, controlling the movement of everything within reach. Exhausting at sustained use; the body pays for what the expression commands.

Elemental Command.name: Elemental Command
Elemental Command.description: Sustain and shape the user's primary elemental expression at full environmental scale, controlling temperature, material state, or atmospheric conditions across an entire space. The area obeys; the user's reserves set the clock.

Sensory Dominion.name: Sensory Dominion
Sensory Dominion.description: Extend trained perception across an entire structure or area, processing all sensory input within range simultaneously. Cognitive overload is the natural ceiling; the information is real and all of it arrives at once.

Vital Authority.name: Vital Authority
Vital Authority.description: Exercise full biological field awareness and control within direct range, stabilizing critical patients, identifying toxins, and supporting multiple recovery processes simultaneously. The healer's body absorbs proportional strain.

Material Sovereignty.name: Material Sovereignty
Material Sovereignty.description: Perceive, assess, and manipulate material properties across a wide area, identifying every structural weakness and stress point simultaneously. Intervention requires contact; awareness does not.

Radiant Authority.name: Radiant Authority
Radiant Authority.description: Command light and radiance across an entire environment, composing, directing, and sustaining effects that reshape visibility, mark targets, and control attention across a wide space.

Crimson Tempest.name: Crimson Tempest
Crimson Tempest.description: Release and sustain crimson energy at full output, maintaining directed force across multiple targets or sustaining a single overwhelming discharge. The body's tolerance is the hard limit; exceeding it causes real internal damage.

Full Embodiment.name: Full Embodiment
Full Embodiment.description: Achieve complete resonance with the user's embodiment path, sustaining maximum output across all practiced expressions simultaneously. The Elyri body is the instrument; even it has thresholds that cost something to cross.

Blade Sovereignty.name: Blade Sovereignty
Blade Sovereignty.description: Master-level blade control that seamlessly integrates offense, defense, movement, and spatial awareness into a single continuous art. Every opening is seen; exploiting them still requires the body to keep up.

Living Weapon.name: Living Weapon
Living Weapon.description: Complete integration of striking, grappling, and defensive technique into an instinctive martial whole that adapts to any opponent in real time. Mastery does not make the body invulnerable; it makes every movement count.

Unbreakable Guard.name: Unbreakable Guard
Unbreakable Guard.description: Sustain a defensive position that no single opponent can penetrate, absorbing and redirecting attacks with trained precision. Multiple coordinated attackers eventually find the seam; one never does.

Grand Working.name: Grand Working
Grand Working.description: Conduct a complex, multi-layered magical working that combines multiple disciplines into a single sustained operation. Preparation, material, and the practitioner's reserves all set hard limits on what a grand working can attempt.

Aerial Supremacy.name: Aerial Supremacy
Aerial Supremacy.description: Absolute control in three-dimensional combat, combining Starian flight with trained engagement techniques at speeds and angles that ground-bound opponents cannot match. Gravity is not absent; it is managed.

Marksman's Authority.name: Marksman's Authority
Marksman's Authority.description: Maintain precise fire under any conditions — distance, movement, stress, environmental interference — with consistent accuracy and controlled ammunition expenditure. The weapon's limits remain real.

Absolute Protection.name: Absolute Protection
Absolute Protection.description: Maintain protective coverage that adapts to any threat vector, repositioning to intercept dangers before they develop while moving charges through hostile territory. One protector, one body, finite attention.

Tactical Assessment.name: Tactical Assessment
Tactical Assessment.description: Read a fight's flow and identify the highest-priority threat or opportunity in the current engagement. The assessment is only as good as the information visible; concealed threats remain concealed.

Steady Hand.name: Steady Hand
Steady Hand.description: Maintain precision under pressure — whether in surgery, delicate repair, aim, or inscription — when circumstances would normally degrade fine motor control.

Quick Patch.name: Quick Patch
Quick Patch.description: Execute an emergency field repair on equipment, structures, or vehicles under time pressure using available materials. The repair is functional, not permanent.

Social Read.name: Social Read
Social Read.description: Perceive the unspoken dynamics in a conversation or negotiation — who holds power, who is bluffing, and what is not being said. Cannot detect thoughts; only trained observation of behavior.

Controlled Breathing.name: Controlled Breathing
Controlled Breathing.description: Regulate physical state through disciplined breathing, managing pain, stress, or fatigue to maintain functional capacity. Does not heal; delays the consequences of accumulated strain.

Route Memory.name: Route Memory
Route Memory.description: Navigate efficiently through complex or unfamiliar urban environments by retaining spatial layout from a single pass. Changes since the last visit are not accounted for.

Evidence Chain.name: Evidence Chain
Evidence Chain.description: Connect physical evidence into a coherent investigative sequence, identifying what happened, in what order, and what is missing from the visible record.

Defensive Position.name: Defensive Position
Defensive Position.description: Hold ground against multiple threats through disciplined positioning, managing engagement angles and distance to prevent being overwhelmed. The position must be defensible; open ground offers nothing to hold.

Emergency Stabilization.name: Emergency Stabilization
Emergency Stabilization.description: Stabilize a critically injured person with available materials, preventing immediate death while proper care is arranged. Not treatment; time purchased.

Silent Approach.name: Silent Approach
Silent Approach.description: Move through occupied space without alerting occupants, controlling noise, visibility, and timing to reach a position undetected. Active searchers and security systems still apply.

Focused Strike.name: Focused Strike
Focused Strike.description: Deliver a precisely targeted hit to an identified vulnerability, maximizing effect from a single committed action. Requires the vulnerability to be correctly identified first.

Crowd Awareness.name: Crowd Awareness
Crowd Awareness.description: Track multiple opponents' positions and intentions in a group fight, maintaining spatial awareness of threats that are not the current engagement.

Contact Leverage.name: Contact Leverage
Contact Leverage.description: Use an established relationship to access information, resources, or introduction that would otherwise require formal channels or direct authority.

Diplomatic Recovery.name: Diplomatic Recovery
Diplomatic Recovery.description: Recover a deteriorating negotiation through composure and reframing, finding new ground when the original position has collapsed. Cannot create willingness where none exists.

Authority Command.name: Authority Command
Authority Command.description: Issue orders that carry weight in a crisis, earning compliance from people not under your formal command through demonstrated competence and composure.

Working Perception.name: Working Perception
Working Perception.description: Perceive an active magical working or residual inscription without specialized tools, identifying its approximate nature, strength, and age. Details require closer examination.

Affinity Push.name: Affinity Push
Affinity Push.description: Push a personal affinity expression slightly beyond its comfortable range in a moment of need, producing a stronger or wider effect than normal practice sustains. The overreach costs proportionally.

Tactical Pivot.name: Tactical Pivot
Tactical Pivot.description: Change strategy mid-engagement, repositioning and redirecting effort to exploit a newly identified advantage. The pivot itself creates a moment of vulnerability that a prepared opponent can exploit.

Precision Exploitation.name: Precision Exploitation
Precision Exploitation.description: Identify and exploit structural weak points in armor, equipment, or defensive posture with consistent accuracy under combat conditions. The weak point must be real; imagined vulnerabilities yield nothing.

Endurance Reserve.name: Endurance Reserve
Endurance Reserve.description: Draw on physical reserves to sustain effort beyond normal limits, maintaining performance when the body signals it should stop. The reserves are real and finite; they repay themselves in recovery time.

Network Activation.name: Network Activation
Network Activation.description: Call on established contacts for time-sensitive information or support, leveraging maintained relationships for immediate practical benefit. Contacts are people with their own interests and limits.

Sustained Working.name: Sustained Working
Sustained Working.description: Maintain a magical working at full effectiveness over an extended period, preventing the natural degradation that normally limits working duration. The practitioner's reserves set the hard ceiling.

Instructive Correction.name: Instructive Correction
Instructive Correction.description: Identify and correct a specific flaw in another person's technique during practice, accelerating their improvement. The correction must be accurate; teaching the wrong fix embeds it.

Operational Command.name: Operational Command
Operational Command.description: Manage a complex multi-person operation under active pressure, maintaining coordination, delegation, and decision flow when circumstances change faster than plans anticipated.

Advanced Recovery.name: Advanced Recovery
Advanced Recovery.description: Treat complex injuries with limited resources under field conditions, performing interventions that normally require proper facilities. Improvisation has limits; some injuries require what is not available.

Adaptive Learning.name: Adaptive Learning
Adaptive Learning.description: Draw on broad human adaptability to pick up patterns and adjust behaviour in unfamiliar situations faster than specialised training alone would explain. The advantage is marginal and situational, not a replacement for actual skill.

Social Leverage.name: Social Leverage
Social Leverage.description: Apply instinctive social reading and conversational positioning to shift a negotiation, defuse tension, or establish rapport in situations where cultural or species barriers would normally slow things down.

Rapid Adaptation.name: Rapid Adaptation
Rapid Adaptation.description: Process changing conditions and revise approach mid-situation with practised speed. The adaptation is conscious and trained, not automatic—it requires attention and costs focus.

Human Tenacity.name: Human Tenacity
Human Tenacity.description: Sustain effort, attention, and composure through conditions that would break concentration in most practitioners. Human tenacity is real but not infinite—the body and mind pay for what willpower demands.

Keen Hearing.name: Keen Hearing
Keen Hearing.description: Focus Kharai hearing to isolate specific sounds from ambient noise at the range and resolution the body’s ears actually support. Training improves discrimination; it does not extend physical hearing range beyond biological limits.

Scent Read.name: Scent Read
Scent Read.description: Identify emotional state indicators, substance traces, or recent presence through scent within actual olfactory capability. Conditions like wind, distance, contamination, and unfamiliar chemistry all limit reliability.

Predator's Focus.name: Predator's Focus
Predator's Focus.description: Layer auditory and olfactory data into a focused awareness state that tracks movement, position, and intent in the immediate area. Requires concentration and degrades with sensory overload.

Sensory Overlay.name: Sensory Overlay
Sensory Overlay.description: Construct a detailed environmental picture from hearing and scent working in concert, identifying individuals, tracking movement patterns, and detecting concealed presence within practical range. The combined load is taxing.

Apex Senses.name: Apex Senses
Apex Senses.description: Peak Kharai sensory processing—sound separation, scent discrimination, and environmental awareness operating at the outer limit of trained biology. Nothing in practical range moves or changes without registering. Sustained use is exhausting.

Precise Touch.name: Precise Touch
Precise Touch.description: Manipulate small, delicate, or intricate objects with the fine motor control Rivani biology supports. The advantage is physical dexterity, not knowledge—a Rivani still needs training for any specialised task.

Nimble Evasion.name: Nimble Evasion
Nimble Evasion.description: Use compact build and practised agility to slip through gaps, avoid strikes, and reposition in tight spaces where larger bodies cannot follow. Effective within actual physical limits.

Surgical Precision.name: Surgical Precision
Surgical Precision.description: Apply fine motor control under pressure to any task requiring exact hand placement and timing—disarming a mechanism, placing a stitch, threading a connection. Steadiness degrades with fatigue and injury.

Blur Step.name: Blur Step
Blur Step.description: Combine practised dexterity with evasive movement to reposition and act in the same motion, making it difficult for opponents to track or predict Rivani movement. Speed is biological, not supernatural.

Rivani Mastery.name: Rivani Mastery
Rivani Mastery.description: Peak Rivani manual precision and body control operating at the biological limit. Hands work with speed and accuracy that standard-scale observation struggles to follow. The body pays for sustained performance.

Surface Adaptation.name: Surface Adaptation
Surface Adaptation.description: Shift surface texture, colour, and apparent composition within the core pattern’s range. The change is controlled and deliberate, not instantaneous disguise—close inspection under good conditions reveals the reshaping.

Structural Compression.name: Structural Compression
Structural Compression.description: Compress body structure to pass through physically suitable constrictions or expand to fill a space, maintaining mass conservation and core-pattern integrity throughout. Duration limited by fatigue.

Complete Restructure.name: Complete Restructure
Complete Restructure.description: Full-body restructure within mass and core-pattern limits—rapid, precise, and held under physical and mental stress. The most demanding form of Olyth reshaping, requiring years of practised control.

System Interface.name: System Interface
System Interface.description: Interface with standard electronic systems through practised technical aptitude and familiarity with common architectures. This is trained competence, not wireless access or innate machine control—physical interface and appropriate knowledge are still required.

Rapid Diagnostics.name: Rapid Diagnostics
Rapid Diagnostics.description: Identify system faults and component states through efficient diagnostic routines developed from Zencadian technical culture. Speed comes from pattern recognition, not omniscience.

Network Navigation.name: Network Navigation
Network Navigation.description: Navigate connected network infrastructure with practised efficiency, mapping topology and locating resources through systematic technical process. Access still requires credentials and appropriate interface.

Machine Rapport.name: Machine Rapport
Machine Rapport.description: Read complex system behaviour with an intuition built from deep technical experience—anticipating failures, identifying performance patterns, and understanding machine state from minimal indicators.

Digital Sovereignty.name: Digital Sovereignty
Digital Sovereignty.description: Command local digital infrastructure with the authority of complete technical mastery. Every system in operational range responds to deliberate, skilled intervention. The expertise is real but not magical—hostile security, hardware limits, and unfamiliar architectures still apply.

Natural Attunement.name: Natural Attunement
Natural Attunement.description: Sense the resonant condition of the immediate environment through Elyri biology—whether a space is settled or disturbed, whether workings are active nearby, whether living things are present. The sense is general, not specific.

Living Presence.name: Living Presence
Living Presence.description: Project an unmistakable presence that registers on others as calm authority, warmth, or warning depending on intent. The effect is biological and social, not psychic—it can be ignored or resisted.

Resonant Pulse.name: Resonant Pulse
Resonant Pulse.description: Send a brief resonant pulse through the local field, revealing active workings, hidden disruptions, or concealed affinity use within short range. The pulse is detectable by other field-sensitive individuals.

Deep Resonance.name: Deep Resonance
Deep Resonance.description: Read the structural condition of magical, biological, or affinity fields through sustained resonant contact. Identifies damage, tampering, and hidden function within the local field at a level of detail that requires extensive Elyri training.

Elyri Integration.name: Elyri Integration
Elyri Integration.description: Full resonant integration with the local field within Elyri biological limits. The environment’s resonant structure becomes an extension of practised awareness—changes register immediately, and deliberate resonant influence becomes precise. Sustained use demands proportional recovery.

Hover Precision.name: Hover Precision
Hover Precision.description: Hold a precise hover position in complex airspace—beside a structure, inside a shaft, in crosswinds—with the control that basic flight does not guarantee. Requires active attention to wind and load.

Aerial Survey.name: Aerial Survey
Aerial Survey.description: Read terrain, movement, and threat patterns from altitude using flight-trained spatial awareness. The survey is visual and positional, limited by actual visibility and attention span.

Flight Mastery.name: Flight Mastery
Flight Mastery.description: Peak aerial capability—speed, endurance, precision, and load management all operating at the biological limit. Decades of flight experience compressed into reflexive aerial judgement. The body still sets the ceiling.

Gravitational Command.name: Gravitational Command
Gravitational Command.description: Command gravitational vectors across the immediate area—redirecting falls, pinning movement, altering trajectory. The body mediates every vector; sustained command exhausts proportionally.

Orbital Mastery.name: Orbital Mastery
Orbital Mastery.description: Control orbital momentum paths with precision that allows mid-flight course correction, object retrieval, and momentum transfer between targets. Range and object mass are hard limits.

Absolute Anchor.name: Absolute Anchor
Absolute Anchor.description: Lock spatial position so completely that external force fails to displace the anchored point. The anchor holds until the practitioner’s field strength is exceeded or concentration breaks.

Mass Authority.name: Mass Authority
Mass Authority.description: Control local density fields to make objects and surfaces effectively heavier or lighter within the expression’s range. Mass is redistributed, not created—conservation applies.

Inertial Command.name: Inertial Command
Inertial Command.description: Strip or transfer inertia from moving objects and people within the practised range with enough precision to stop a vehicle or cushion a structural collapse. Energy has to go somewhere.

Impact Sovereignty.name: Impact Sovereignty
Impact Sovereignty.description: Absorb and redistribute impact energy at a scale that handles structural-grade forces—explosions, collisions, falling debris. The absorbed energy must be dissipated; holding it is dangerous.

Kinetic Cascade.name: Kinetic Cascade
Kinetic Cascade.description: Store, layer, and release kinetic energy in a controlled cascade that multiplies impact beyond what a single strike could deliver. Each release costs what was stored; the body is the capacitor.

Vector Sovereignty.name: Vector Sovereignty
Vector Sovereignty.description: Lock movement vectors in the local area with enough precision and range to freeze a corridor, redirect a charging group, or halt projectiles mid-flight. Concentration demands are extreme.

Tectonic Authority.name: Tectonic Authority
Tectonic Authority.description: Command stone and volcanic material at structural scale—raise barriers, open passages, redirect flow. The expression moves what exists; it does not create material or sustain changes without attention.

Glacial Command.name: Glacial Command
Glacial Command.description: Draw heat from the immediate area with enough control and range to freeze surfaces, create barriers of solid ice, and drop ambient temperature to dangerous levels. The thermal debt accumulates.

Atmospheric Command.name: Atmospheric Command
Atmospheric Command.description: Redirect air currents, build or collapse pressure zones, and sustain wind patterns within the local area. Effective outdoors and in large spaces; walls and structures constrain the expression.

Pressure Dominion.name: Pressure Dominion
Pressure Dominion.description: Generate and direct shearing pressure forces with enough control to cut, separate, or deflect at range. The forces are real and dangerous—collateral control requires full attention.

Metal Mastery.name: Metal Mastery
Metal Mastery.description: Shape, move, and restructure ferrous and compatible metal at a scale and speed that approaches fabrication. The expression works with what is present; alloy complexity and mass set hard limits.

Electromagnetic Sovereignty.name: Electromagnetic Sovereignty
Electromagnetic Sovereignty.description: Perceive and redirect electromagnetic fields across the local area with enough range and precision to disable electronics, deflect energy, or create localised interference patterns. Sustained use produces visible strain.

Route Mastery.name: Route Mastery
Route Mastery.description: Perceive every viable route, passage, and spatial connection in the local area simultaneously—hidden doors, structural shortcuts, escape paths. The spatial map is real-time but limited to what the expression can reach.

Seismic Authority.name: Seismic Authority
Seismic Authority.description: Read structural state through vibration at a range and resolution that reveals hidden spaces, weight distribution, stress fractures, and active movement within an entire building or comparable structure.

Machine Authority.name: Machine Authority
Machine Authority.description: Perceive the operational state of every machine and electronic system within the expression’s range—running, damaged, tampered, dormant. The awareness is diagnostic, not control.

Interface Mastery.name: Interface Mastery
Interface Mastery.description: Adapt touch response to any physical interface with enough speed and precision to operate unfamiliar controls, bypass mechanical locks, and manipulate sensitive instruments at expert level.

Provenance Mastery.name: Provenance Mastery
Provenance Mastery.description: Read the full material history of a handled object—origin, composition, contamination, prior handling, and alteration—at a resolution that standard inspection cannot match.

Thermal Authority.name: Thermal Authority
Thermal Authority.description: Map thermal signatures across an entire area in real time—body heat, residual warmth, cold spots, hidden fires, insulated compartments. Resolution degrades with distance and interference.

Luminous Mastery.name: Luminous Mastery
Luminous Mastery.description: Reconstruct recent light events in a space—who was present, what was illuminated, how light moved—from residual optical data the expression can reach. Ambient light and time since the event set limits.

Acoustic Mastery.name: Acoustic Mastery
Acoustic Mastery.description: Separate, isolate, or suppress any sound source within the expression’s range with enough precision to create silence zones, extract whispered conversation from noise, or shape the acoustic environment.

Vocal Authority.name: Vocal Authority
Vocal Authority.description: Project voice with controlled resonance that carries clearly through noise, distance, and interference, or modulate to frequencies that produce specific physiological responses. The voice is still biological-range.

Emotional Sovereignty.name: Emotional Sovereignty
Emotional Sovereignty.description: Perceive and influence the emotional state of individuals in the immediate area with enough precision to calm panic, destabilise composure, or detect deception through emotional signature. Influence is not control.

Impression Authority.name: Impression Authority
Impression Authority.description: Extract detailed psychometric impressions from objects—events, emotions, and identities associated with sustained contact. Older or fainter impressions require more effort and yield less detail.

Neural Command.name: Neural Command
Neural Command.description: Perceive neural stress states in living beings within range—pain, exhaustion, injury location, cognitive load—with diagnostic precision. The sense reads; it does not heal or cause.

Cognitive Mastery.name: Cognitive Mastery
Cognitive Mastery.description: Maintain multiple independent cognitive threads and conceptual connections simultaneously at a level that allows real-time analysis of complex systems, parallel problem-solving, and accelerated learning.

Shadow Mastery.name: Shadow Mastery
Shadow Mastery.description: Bend light and perception around a person or area with enough control to create functional invisibility within the expression’s limits. Active detection methods, close proximity, and sustained use all degrade the concealment.

Structural Authority.name: Structural Authority
Structural Authority.description: Stabilise, join, and reinforce structures at a scale that handles building-grade stress—collapsing walls, failing supports, breached hulls. The expression holds what is there; it does not replace missing material.

Mantle Dominion.name: Mantle Dominion
Mantle Dominion.description: Extend the aether mantle into a complete defensive envelope that absorbs, redirects, and dissipates incoming force at structural scale. Sustained operation drains at a rate proportional to what the mantle intercepts.

Lance Sovereignty.name: Lance Sovereignty
Lance Sovereignty.description: Focus and sustain coherent radiant output at peak intensity—precise enough to cut, powerful enough to breach, and controllable enough to discriminate targets in close proximity.

Ascendant Flight.name: Ascendant Flight
Ascendant Flight.description: Fieldborne flight operating at peak embodied capacity—speed, altitude, endurance, and manoeuvrability at the biological ceiling. The field sustains what the body can tolerate.

Grand Architecture.name: Grand Architecture
Grand Architecture.description: Conjure and sustain resonant structures at architectural scale—platforms, barriers, bridges, enclosures—with enough stability and detail to serve as functional construction. Duration limited by field reserves.

Restoration Authority.name: Restoration Authority
Restoration Authority.description: Sustain restorative contact at a scale and depth that accelerates biological recovery from severe injury, stabilises failing systems, and supports extended treatment. The practitioner’s reserves set the ceiling.

Severance Authority.name: Severance Authority
Severance Authority.description: Break resonant connections—magical workings, affinity expressions, embodied effects—with precision that isolates the target from its source without collateral disruption. Stronger connections require more effort.

Concordant Command.name: Concordant Command
Concordant Command.description: Channel willing concordance into a sustained operational state that amplifies the combined capability of every participant. The surge scales with the number and commitment of willing contributors.

Gravity Well.name: Gravity Well
Gravity Well.description: Create a localised gravity increase centred on a point, slowing movement and pulling loose objects inward. Range and intensity limited by field strength.

Kinetic Siphon.name: Kinetic Siphon
Kinetic Siphon.description: Drain kinetic energy from objects and people in contact range, slowing them and storing the energy for later release. The siphoned energy must be used or dissipated.

Kinetic Infusion.name: Kinetic Infusion
Kinetic Infusion.description: Infuse kinetic energy into an object or ally through direct contact, boosting their next physical action. The transfer is one-way and the boost is temporary.

Controlled Burn.name: Controlled Burn
Controlled Burn.description: Sustain thermal output at a precise level—hot enough to weld, warm enough to cauterise, steady enough to light a corridor without fire hazard. Control, not power.

Cold Snap.name: Cold Snap
Cold Snap.description: Drop temperature across a defined area rapidly enough to create frost, ice slicks, and fog. Duration depends on ambient conditions and sustained attention.

Ferrous Strike.name: Ferrous Strike
Ferrous Strike.description: Shape available metal into a fast-moving projectile or striking surface and direct it at a target. Speed and impact scale with available metal mass.

Radiant Shield.name: Radiant Shield
Radiant Shield.description: Concentrate radiant output into a defensive barrier of compressed light that deflects physical and energy-based attacks. Brightness makes the user impossible to miss.

Crimson Barrier.name: Crimson Barrier
Crimson Barrier.description: Shape crimson energy into a defensive wall or shell that absorbs incoming force and returns it as heat. The barrier is visible and drains with each impact.

System Override.name: System Override
System Override.description: Push machine-state awareness past observation into influence—nudge electrical systems toward a state, trigger fault conditions, or force emergency stops through field contact.

Silence Zone.name: Silence Zone
Silence Zone.description: Create a defined zone of near-complete silence by absorbing all sound entering or generated within the boundary. Useful for stealth, communication privacy, and sensory denial.

Emotional Disruption.name: Emotional Disruption
Emotional Disruption.description: Push emotional regulation from reading into targeted influence—amplify anxiety, suppress aggression, or destabilise emotional composure in a single target. Influence is not override.

Accelerated Triage.name: Accelerated Triage
Accelerated Triage.description: Apply recovery support at emergency speed—identifying the worst injury, stabilising vital function, and prioritising biological repair across multiple patients. Speed costs precision.

Pattern Disruption.name: Pattern Disruption
Pattern Disruption.description: Feed false or contradictory pattern data into a target’s perception, degrading their ability to predict, track, or analyse. The disruption is subtle and temporary.

Coherent Beam.name: Coherent Beam
Coherent Beam.description: Narrow radiant output to a single sustained beam of maximum precision—surgical cutting, targeted destruction, or focused illumination at extreme range. Power trades for width.

Targeted Severance.name: Targeted Severance
Targeted Severance.description: Apply severance to a single specific connection with enough precision to break one working, one bond, or one active expression without affecting anything else in the field.

Radiant Working.name: Radiant Working
Radiant Working.description: Conduct a working of pure light at peak discipline—sustained illumination, signal projection, or light-based effect at a scale and precision that approaches the theoretical limit of the craft.

Thermal Mastery.name: Thermal Mastery
Thermal Mastery.description: Control thermal magical effects with the precision and scale of mastery-level practice—targeted heating, area cooling, thermal barriers, and fire management at a level that defines the standard.

Force Dominion.name: Force Dominion
Force Dominion.description: Apply directed magical force at structural scale with controlled precision—enough to move walls, redirect vehicles, or pin a crowd. The practitioner’s reserves and channelling set the ceiling.

Grand Ward.name: Grand Ward
Grand Ward.description: Inscribe and sustain a warding system that protects an area against multiple threat types simultaneously—physical breach, magical intrusion, affinity interference. Maintenance costs scale with coverage.

Binding Authority.name: Binding Authority
Binding Authority.description: Establish a containment working that holds against sustained resistance from physical force, magical countermeasures, and affinity-based escape. The binding adapts to what it contains.

Detection Mastery.name: Detection Mastery
Detection Mastery.description: Survey an area for magical signatures, active workings, residual traces, and hidden inscriptions at a resolution that reveals what standard detection misses. Range and duration limited by concentration.

Preservation Authority.name: Preservation Authority
Preservation Authority.description: Apply preservation workings at a scale and durability that maintains material, biological, or structural integrity indefinitely under normal conditions. Extreme environments and active interference degrade over time.

Route Command.name: Route Command
Route Command.description: Establish a route-working network that provides navigation, waypoint communication, and movement assistance across a large area. The network persists independently once inscribed.

Seal Mastery.name: Seal Mastery
Seal Mastery.description: Authenticate, audit, and maintain magical workings at mastery level—diagnosing failure modes, repairing degraded inscriptions, and verifying seal integrity across complex systems.

Blinding Flash.name: Blinding Flash
Blinding Flash.description: Concentrate light output into a sudden, intense burst that overwhelms vision and disrupts attention. Effective against anyone relying on sight in the affected area.

Thermal Strike.name: Thermal Strike
Thermal Strike.description: Channel thermal magic into a focused strike—a jet of heat, a freezing contact, or a thermal shockwave directed at a single target. The strike depletes prepared reserves.

Force Shield.name: Force Shield
Force Shield.description: Shape directed force into a defensive barrier that absorbs or redirects incoming physical and energy attacks. The shield drains with each impact and requires continuous channelling.

Ward Trap.name: Ward Trap
Ward Trap.description: Inscribe a ward that activates on specific trigger conditions—proximity, identity, or magical signature—delivering a defensive response to the intruder. Complexity limited by preparation time.

Binding Bolt.name: Binding Bolt
Binding Bolt.description: Project binding force at range as a targeted restraint that latches onto a single subject. Less durable than a prepared circle but deployable in combat without setup.

Warded Force.name: Warded Force
Warded Force.description: Channel directed force through a warding structure, creating a shielded strike that protects the caster during delivery. The combined cost is higher than either working alone.

Illuminated Detection.name: Illuminated Detection
Illuminated Detection.description: Use structured light as a detection medium—the working illuminates magical signatures, active effects, and concealed inscriptions that standard light and standard detection individually miss.

Thermal Binding.name: Thermal Binding
Thermal Binding.description: Reinforce a binding working with thermal magic—the restraint radiates heat or cold that punishes escape attempts and degrades tools used against it.

Healing Light.name: Healing Light
Healing Light.description: Channel healing through structured light, allowing treatment at range and through visual contact rather than physical touch. Range and precision limited by line of sight.

Force Containment.name: Force Containment
Force Containment.description: Reinforce a binding circle with directed force that physically restrains the subject independent of the magical containment. Two layers of restraint—magical and physical.

Preserved Route.name: Preserved Route
Preserved Route.description: Route marks inscribed with preservation enchantment that resist weathering, magical interference, and physical damage. The combined working is harder to establish but lasts proportionally longer.

Sealed Ward.name: Sealed Ward
Sealed Ward.description: A ward inscribed with authentication that responds only to authorised individuals—others trigger the defensive response, while cleared personnel pass without resistance.

Detection Seal.name: Detection Seal
Detection Seal.description: Inspect sealed workings and authenticated objects to verify integrity, detect tampering, and identify unauthorised modifications without breaking the seal.

Binding Seal.name: Binding Seal
Binding Seal.description: An authenticated binding that resists unauthorised release—only the caster or designated individuals can lower the restraint. Attempted bypass triggers a defensive response.

Route Ward.name: Route Ward
Route Ward.description: Route marks protected by integrated warding that deflects interference, resists tampering, and alerts the inscriber to attempted disruption along the network.

Controlled Takedown.name: Controlled Takedown
Controlled Takedown.description: Apply restraint techniques designed to subdue without causing lasting injury—joint control, position management, and controlled pressure. Requires physical contact and favourable positioning.

Political Maneuvering.name: Political Maneuvering
Political Maneuvering.description: Navigate inter-house political dynamics with practised competence—reading faction positions, identifying leverage points, and timing proposals for maximum effect.

Rapid Recovery.name: Rapid Recovery
Rapid Recovery.description: Apply trained recovery protocols at field speed—wound management, stabilisation, and functional return faster than standard first aid allows.

Research Breakthrough.name: Research Breakthrough
Research Breakthrough.description: Connect disparate archival sources into a coherent finding through trained research methodology. The breakthrough comes from systematic process, not inspiration.

Efficient Operation.name: Efficient Operation
Efficient Operation.description: Optimise resource allocation and operational planning to extend supplies, reduce waste, and maintain capability with less than standard requirements.

Cold Response.name: Cold Response
Cold Response.description: Maintain operational composure under deliberate provocation—verbal, physical, or situational—without the emotional response the provocation is designed to produce.

Threat Assessment.name: Threat Assessment
Threat Assessment.description: Evaluate threat levels, identify tactical priorities, and assess operational risk in real time based on trained awareness patterns.

Stable Channel.name: Stable Channel
Stable Channel.description: Maintain a sustained channelling state under distraction, movement, and mild physical stress. The working holds steady because the discipline is practised, not because the environment cooperates.

Lightened Haul.name: Lightened Haul
Lightened Haul.description:
Reduce the effective downward pull on a single object you are carrying or lifting with your hands so that it can be raised, shifted or carried further than your muscles alone would manage.

The object must be in your grip or braced against your body; the lightening ends the moment contact breaks and the load returns in full. Awkward balance, fragile contents and poor footing are unchanged, and nothing heavier than you could shift with real effort becomes movable. It does not launch, throw or float the object and cannot be applied to a person.

[innate biological action]

Tilted Floor.name: Tilted Floor
Tilted Floor.description:
Impose a sloped gravitational gradient across a room-sized floor or platform so that loose objects and unbraced people slide toward the edge you choose.

The slope is felt only by what rests on that surface and holds only while your attention holds; walking away or taking a blow lets it flatten. Braced or anchored bodies resist it, heavy fixtures barely stir, and it cannot lift anything clear of the ground, invert the space or reach through walls. Extending it past a single connected surface brings strain quickly.

[innate biological action]

Cargo Suspension.name: Cargo Suspension
Cargo Suspension.description:
Cancel most of the pull on a single massive object, a stalled vehicle, a fallen beam, a loaded pallet, so that a small team can walk it clear.

You must keep a hand or shoulder on the mass, and the body mediates every part of that load: minutes of holding a vehicle-scale mass bring shaking, nosebleeds and the kind of strain that sends practitioners to a clinic. The object does not float free or become throwable, its inertia is untouched, and living bodies cannot be suspended this way.

[innate biological action]

Divided Pull.name: Divided Pull
Divided Pull.description:
Hold separate, differently signed gravitational adjustments on several bodies at once across the immediate area: pinning an attacker, lightening a falling ally, sloping the ground under a third.

Each adjustment is a distinct thread you must keep in mind, and every added thread degrades the precision of the others; losing composure drops them all together. Nothing here exceeds what the single applications can do, nothing is crushed or ruptured, no field reaches past clear sight, and the body's strain climbs with the number of threads held, not only the mass.

[innate biological action]

Kept Circling.name: Kept Circling
Kept Circling.description:
Keep a single small loose object circling your position in a steady path while your hands and most of your attention stay free for other work.

You must set the object moving yourself; the path holds through ordinary walking and talking but breaks when you are struck, sprint or lose concentration, and the object then falls or flies off along its last line. Only something you could throw with a hand can be kept, nothing is created, and the circling object does not strike, shield or track targets on its own.

[innate biological action]

Displaced Pivot.name: Displaced Pivot
Displaced Pivot.description:
Establish the centre of an orbital path away from your own body, at a doorway, around an ally or above a chosen point, and keep loose objects circling there.

The pivot must be in clear sight and reasonably close; every stride of distance loosens the arc and lets fast objects escape. The path still needs real motion to begin, still obeys the mass and range limits of the expression, and collapses when your line of sight is broken or the pivot moves faster than you can track it.

[innate biological action]

Debris Ring.name: Debris Ring
Debris Ring.description:
Gather many loose fragments, gravel, shards, tools, spent casings, into a single sustained ring around your body or a chosen pivot, turning fast enough to deflect thrown and light projectiles and to discourage approach.

The ring is only as dense as the loose material actually present; it will not stop a sustained firearm volley, a heavy object or a determined rush, and fragments that strike something drop out of it. Holding a dense ring while moving is tiring, and any fragment you lose track of is a hazard to everyone nearby, allies included.

[innate biological action]

Slingshot Turn.name: Slingshot Turn
Slingshot Turn.description:
Treat your own flying body as the orbiting mass around a fixed anchor, a pillar, a mast, a hovering companion, to whip through a turn or reversal far tighter than wing and muscle alone allow.

The anchor must be solid and within a short reach of flight; misjudging it throws you off line rather than around it. The turn is a single arc, not sustained circling, and it delivers you at the speed you brought, with all of that impact if you meet something. Repeated turns in quick succession bring vertigo, nausea and the strain of the expression working on your own mass.

[innate biological action]

Fixed Footing.name: Fixed Footing
Fixed Footing.description:
Anchor your own stance to the surface beneath you so that a lurching deck, a tilting platform, a gust or a shove does not move you from where you stand.

You remain fixed relative to the surface, not to the world: if the platform falls, you fall with it. The hold lasts a short while and ends when you step, and a force strong enough to move the surface itself, or to injure you, breaks it. It does not steady anyone else, brace an object or make a bad foothold safe.

[innate biological action]

Kept Interval.name: Kept Interval
Kept Interval.description:
Hold a fixed separation between a pair of objects in sight, a swinging load and its crane hook, a loose door and its frame, a drifting boat and a jetty, without touching either.

Both must be visible and close, and the interval holds only against ordinary disturbance: wind, current, a stumble, slow drift. A violent pull or a heavy mass already in motion snaps it, and neither object is held to the ground, only to each other. Concentration is continuous and the strain grows with the mass involved and the time held.

[innate biological action]

Collapse Stay.name: Collapse Stay
Collapse Stay.description:
Hold a failing structural element, a cracked lintel, a sagging span, a wall section that has begun to lean, in its present position long enough for people to get clear.

The stay borrows nothing from the structure; the full weight of what would fall is mediated through your body, and minutes of holding a large mass bring shaking, blurred vision and injury. It cannot repair the element, lift it back or make it safe, and once you release or fail, the collapse proceeds as it would have.

[innate biological action]

Carried Frame.name: Carried Frame
Carried Frame.description:
Anchor several objects or people to your own moving body as their reference frame, so that a wounded companion, a load or a strung set of equipment stays fixed relative to you as you fly or run, without hands or straps.

Everything carried still has its own mass, and every anchored body draws on your strength and attention together; sharp manoeuvres, a hit or a lapse in concentration lets one or more of them slip. The frame does not protect what it carries from impact, weather or fire, and it cannot hold an unwilling, struggling person.

[innate biological action]

Working Glow.name: Working Glow
Working Glow.description:
Let a soft, even radiance rise from your skin to light your hands and immediate surroundings for as long as your work lasts.

The light is enough to read, repair, treat a wound or walk a dark corridor; it does not reach far, blind, burn or hide you, and it makes you plainly visible to anyone watching. Holding it for hours is tiring in the way a long shift is tiring, and it stops when you sleep or lose focus.

[innate biological action]

Needle Beam.name: Needle Beam
Needle Beam.description:
Narrow your radiance into a sustained thread of light and heat that scorches, scores or slowly burns through a small point at a distance of clear sight.

The beam is a working tool as much as a weapon: it will cut thin sheet, sever a cord, char a mark or heat a bolt, given time and steadiness, but it does not bore through thick metal, stone or an armoured body, and anything opaque blocks it. Holding it steady on a moving target or while you move yourself is demanding, and the point of contact is visible to everyone.

[innate biological action]

Sunless Heat.name: Sunless Heat
Sunless Heat.description:
Emit your stellar radiance with its visible light suppressed, so that heat alone crosses to a target or a space without any glow to give you away.

The heat behaves as it would from a flare or a beam, warming, scorching or igniting what it reaches, but you lose the aiming mark and the dazzle, and the invisible band is harder to shape; overreach shows first as burns on your own hands. It cannot be sustained as long as visible output, does not pass through solid cover and offers no protection from your own heat.

[innate biological action]

Beacon Column.name: Beacon Column
Beacon Column.description:
Raise a tall column of radiance above your position that stands for as long as you hold it, visible across a district by day or night, hot enough at its base to clear fog and keep the cold off those gathered round it.

The column is a fixed signal and rally point, not a weapon; it does not sweep, strike or shield, and it draws every eye and every hostile toward you. Holding it through hours brings the strain of continuous output, and moving more than a few paces collapses it. A second raising in the same night is a real risk to your health.

[innate biological action]

Grounded Charge.name: Grounded Charge
Grounded Charge.description:
Set crimson force into your legs and core to hold your ground against a single incoming push, tackle, blast wave or shove that would otherwise move you.

The hold is brief and answers a single impact; it does not make you immovable, strike back, or stop something heavy enough to break bone. Bad footing still slides, and taking a second heavy impact before you reset means giving ground or going down. Bracing costs the breath and effort of a hard lift.

[innate biological action]

Shock Stamp.name: Shock Stamp
Shock Stamp.description:
Drive crimson force through your feet into the ground so that a single sharp wave rolls outward in a ring, staggering or toppling those close around you and scattering loose objects.

The wave is short-lived and short-ranged, strongest at arm's reach and spent within a few strides; braced, heavy or airborne opponents shrug it off, and solid floor gives it more bite than soft ground. It does not injure at range, break structures or single anyone out: friends inside the ring are knocked down like everyone else.

[innate biological action]

Ember Stride.name: Ember Stride
Ember Stride.description:
Sustain crimson force through the whole body over an extended exertion, running, climbing, hauling, fighting on, at an output your muscles could not otherwise keep up.

The heat of the expression builds visibly in the skin and breath, and the cost is paid in true fatigue afterward: cramp, dehydration and days of soreness. Pushed past the body's tolerance it causes real internal injury. It lends stamina and force, not speed beyond the body's mechanics, and it does not heal, deaden pain or armour you.

[innate biological action]

Comet Dive.name: Comet Dive
Comet Dive.description:
Commit your entire body's crimson force through a flying charge so that you strike as a single projectile, able to break a barricade, a door, a vehicle panel or an armoured line.

Everything you hit, you hit with; the impact is shared by your own bones, and a poorly judged dive leaves you broken among the wreckage. It is a single straight run, not a sustained assault, cannot be steered once committed, and the strain after use is severe enough that a second attempt in the same fight is a serious risk to life.

[innate biological action]

Cliff Steps.name: Cliff Steps
Cliff Steps.description:
Raise a series of small footholds and handholds out of a contacted stone face as you climb or descend it.

Each hold is formed from the rock beneath your hand as you reach it; the stone must be continuous and workable, and brittle, wet or crumbling rock yields holds that fail. The steps are rough, carry no more than a person, and forming them while hanging by the other hand is slow and tiring. It does not create rock where none exists or make the climb safe.

[innate biological action]

Masonry Knit.name: Masonry Knit
Masonry Knit.description:
Fuse broken stone or masonry along a seam into a single continuous mass, closing a breach, mending a cracked pier or sealing a gap in a wall.

Both pieces must be in contact and of compatible stone; the knit is solid and lasting but no stronger than the surrounding rock, and it will not bridge a void, join stone to metal or reform shattered rubble to a plan. Working a long seam is slow and exhausting, and a join made under load can fail while it sets.

[innate biological action]

Magma Channel.name: Magma Channel
Magma Channel.description:
Where molten rock is actually present, at a vent, a fissure or an active flow, steer its movement: turning a flow, opening a channel, raising a crust of cooled stone across its surface.

The expression moves what exists; it creates no magma, cannot cool a flow faster than air and rock allow and cannot hold back a large flow for long. Heat, gas and collapsing crust are real dangers to you as to anyone nearby, and the effort of shifting molten mass is the heaviest in this lane, producing strain and burns even in success.

[innate biological action]

Tremor Line.name: Tremor Line
Tremor Line.description:
Send a single strong tremor along a chosen line through solid ground, toppling those standing on it, dropping loose stonework and shaking a wall or embankment loose.

The tremor travels only through connected rock or packed earth in the direction you set; it fades with distance, does not follow bends and is felt by everyone on the line, allies included. Structures do not reliably fall and foundations are not opened. A second tremor soon after the first brings cramps, bleeding from the nose and days of recovery.

[innate biological action]

Chill Keeping.name: Chill Keeping
Chill Keeping.description:
Keep a contacted container, medicine, food, a sample, a wound pack, steadily cold over hours with a low, even draw of heat.

The cold is only what preservation needs, not freezing, and it holds while the container stays within reach; sleep, distraction or a long absence lets it warm. Living bodies cannot be kept this way, nothing is chilled at a distance, and the drawn heat has to go somewhere: your hands grow uncomfortably warm and a long hold leaves them stiff.

[innate biological action]

Ice Casting.name: Ice Casting
Ice Casting.description:
Freeze standing or flowing water that is actually present into a chosen solid form: a step, a plug, a splint, a short span across a channel.

Only the water there can be used; shape and thickness depend on how much of it there is, and a cast holds only as long as ambient cold allows. A span will bear a careful person, not a vehicle; a plug will hold pressure for a while, not permanently. Rapid casting of a large volume is hard on you, with numb hands and a deep chill that lingers.

[innate biological action]

Seized Works.name: Seized Works
Seized Works.description:
Draw heat from a running mechanism, an engine, a weapon's action, a door drive, a drone's rotor, until its lubricant gels and its moving parts seize.

The mechanism must be within reach or a short distance and exposed enough for the draw to reach its working parts; sealed or heated systems resist, and large machines take long enough to seize that the operator will notice. The seizure lasts until the parts warm again, causes no lasting damage by itself and does nothing to a person holding the machine.

[innate biological action]

Clinical Chill.name: Clinical Chill
Clinical Chill.description:
Lower the temperature of a contacted living patient evenly and deliberately, cooling a heatstroke, slowing bleeding and swelling, or stabilising someone until surgery.

This is the one point in the lane where a living body may be cooled, and only with genuine medical judgment: uneven, too deep or too fast, the cold does what cold does to flesh. It is care, not attack: it cannot be used at range, cannot be forced on a struggling person and never freezes tissue. Holding a patient's temperature for a long stretch is exhausting and leaves your own hands white.

[innate biological action]

Drying Touch.name: Drying Touch
Drying Touch.description:
Drive moisture out of contacted clothing, gear, wood or ground with steady, even warmth, so soaked kit becomes usable and damp fuel takes flame.

The warming is mild and deliberate; it scorches nothing that is watched, but a hand left too long on one spot will. Large or waterlogged loads take a long time and considerable patience, and it does nothing to living skin beyond ordinary warmth. It is not an attack and cannot dry anything you are not touching.

[innate biological action]

Kindling Point.name: Kindling Point
Kindling Point.description:
Ignite a combustible you can see, a lamp wick, a fuse, dry brush, spilled fuel, from a distance and without contact by projecting a tight point of heat onto it.

The material must actually burn on its own once lit; the point heats what it touches and nothing else, and wind, rain, distance or a moving target throw it off. It will not light stone, wet timber or a person, will not sustain a flame, and once the fire is going it spreads by its own rules, not yours.

[innate biological action]

Melt Through.name: Melt Through
Melt Through.description:
Bring a contacted plate, lock, hinge or bar to melting and cut an opening through it, opening a sealed hatch, freeing a trapped limb from a crushed frame or breaching a thin bulkhead.

Thick or heat-shedding material takes long enough that the effort becomes dangerous to you; the molten edge, the smoke and the heat around the cut are real hazards, and the far side of the cut is not yours to control. Nothing is cut at a distance, nothing living can be worked on, and your own hands and face take the heat first.

[innate biological action]

Searing Line.name: Searing Line
Searing Line.description:
Lay a line of scorching heat across a street, a corridor mouth or a breach that stops an advance: nothing crosses without burns, thin combustibles ignite in it and thrown objects arrive hot.

The line is heat, not flame; it is invisible but for shimmer and the effects it produces, and it can be walked around, jumped by the desperate or crossed by anything sufficiently armoured. Holding it while you move or fight is possible, but the longer it stands the more you burn from the inside; the strain after a long hold is real injury.

[innate biological action]

Clean Draw.name: Clean Draw
Clean Draw.description:
Pull a steady stream of clean air from a better-aired space toward your own face or a small group, keeping smoke, dust or fumes moving away.

There must be breathable air somewhere near to draw on; in a sealed, filled space there is nothing to bring. The stream is narrow and holds only while you keep at it, and it does not filter what is already in the air or reach further than a room. It does not cure exposure, resist pressure or move anything heavier than a curtain.

[innate biological action]

Rising Column.name: Rising Column
Rising Column.description:
Raise a sustained column of ascending air beneath yourself or another flier, giving lift for a hard climb, slowing a fall or holding a hover with less effort.

The column needs open air above and a floor or ground to push from; it does not work under a low ceiling or through a rain of falling debris. It softens a fall rather than stopping it and cannot lift a non-flier off the ground on its own. Holding it under a companion while you yourself fly demands real coordination and grows tiring fast.

[innate biological action]

Breach Seal.name: Breach Seal
Breach Seal.description:
Hold a pressure differential across a breach, a cracked hatch, a sprung seal, a hull tear, keeping breathable air on one side and gas, smoke or vacuum on the other.

The seal is a moving effort, not a barrier; anything solid still passes, the pressure you hold back leaks past you at the edges, and the larger the opening or the difference in pressure, the shorter it lasts. It cannot restore lost air, cannot be held while you sleep, and leaves you dizzy and bleeding from the ears when pushed too far.

[innate biological action]

Formation Tailwind.name: Formation Tailwind
Formation Tailwind.description:
Sustain a moving body of air around your own flight path and several flying companions, giving the formation a tailwind and a smoother ride for a long stretch.

The air must be free; inside structures or in a strong crosswind the tailwind breaks up. It lends speed and range at the cost of your own attention and breath, and everyone in the formation must hold station in it: those who drift lose it. It does not protect from weather or attack, and the effort of a long crossing is the fatigue of a full day's hard march.

[innate biological action]

Seam Split.name: Seam Split
Seam Split.description:
Apply a fine pressure separation along a contacted seam, a jammed lid, a swollen door, a sealed crate, a rusted joint, to open it without tools or damage.

The separation works on things that were made to open and have stuck; welded, bolted or locked seams do not part for it. It is quiet, precise and slow, and pressing a seam with something behind it, pressure, a spring, a person, can end badly. It does not cut, pierce or push anything wider than a hand.

[innate biological action]

Wall Pin.name: Wall Pin
Wall Pin.description:
Pin a person or object against a wall, floor or vehicle side with an opposed pressure shear, holding them without cutting or crushing.
