Every added emission takes stability from the others and pushes the ladder faster; a hard strike or a lapse collapses all of them at once. Precision on any single emission is below what a lone lance achieves. Not an unlimited spread and not a weapon that fires itself.

[Elyri embodied action]

Arrested Fall.name: Arrested Fall
Arrested Fall.description:
Break a fall with a sharp burst of organized current — your own, or that of a person within arm's reach — and bring it to a controlled stop or a survivable landing.

Practiced scope is the single catch: a short height, one body, and a stop that costs a jolt to the core rather than sustained flight. Catching another person needs a grip and enough clearance to slow them; a falling load too heavy for the body to hold pulls the user down with it. This is not a hover, not a rescue at range and not a substitute for practised flight when the fall began high.

[Elyri embodied action]

Confined Passage.name: Confined Passage
Confined Passage.description:
Fly through enclosed, obstructed spaces — shafts, ducts, collapsed interiors, cargo holds — using fine current control where there is no open air to work with.

Expert scope is precision in a tight box: the user moves, reverses and holds position inside walls close enough to touch, carrying a tool or one light passenger, and threads openings the body barely fits. Dust, heat and unstable structure still injure; hitting something still hurts. Speed is walking pace or slower, and the user cannot fight or work with both hands while holding the flight. Not a way through solid material.

[Elyri embodied action]

Dead Weight Lift.name: Dead Weight Lift
Dead Weight Lift.description:
Lift and carry an unconscious adult, a wounded companion or an equivalent inert load through unstable air over a long approach and set them down safely at the far end.

Master scope is sustained load: the flight holds through gusts, downdrafts and disturbed field with a mass that cannot balance itself, paced so the user arrives still able to land. The load must be secured by hand or harness; the current does not grip it. The carry advances fatigue and the overuse ladder throughout, and the user cannot fight or protect the load while carrying. Not a lift for vehicles, not unlimited range and not a safe drop if the core falters mid-flight.

[Elyri embodied action]

Thin Field Crossing.name: Thin Field Crossing
Thin Field Crossing.description:
Cross a region where the field is thin, disturbed or dead — an offworld transit, a damaged installation, the wake of a large working — sustaining flight on the core's own organization when the current has nothing to hold.

Pinnacle scope is flight without support: a bounded crossing planned before it begins, stopped the moment the reserve runs low. Every stretch of thin field is paid from core stability and moves the user down the overuse ladder; there is no gliding to safety if the crossing was misjudged. Speed and lift are below open-field flight, no passengers are carried, and this is not a way to live in vacuum or leave the planet.

[Elyri embodied action]

Set Foothold.name: Set Foothold
Set Foothold.description:
Form a single small foothold, handhold or short ramp of organized energy for one person, or brace a sagging beam, hatch or shelf for the moments it takes to pass.

Practiced scope is one element, one person, held while the user watches it: a step across a gap, a rung on a blank wall, a prop under a sliding load. It does not span, does not stack and does not hold once the user turns away. Weight beyond a single body collapses it, and it cannot cut, lift or seal. Where the element gives out, the person on it falls, so the placement must have a safe failure.

[Elyri embodied action]

Shaped Channel.name: Shaped Channel
Shaped Channel.description:
Shape a hollow, purpose-built form — a chute, a sluice, a funnel, a curved ramp, a lined passage — that directs water, loose material, smoke or moving people along a chosen path.

Expert scope is function: the structure has an inside and an outside, an inlet and an outlet, and it keeps its shape under the pressure of what flows through it. It still needs the user's attention to change shape and cannot grow past what the core supports. A channel is not airtight, not a filter and not a pump; what enters leaves at the far end with the momentum it arrived with. Blocking a flow rather than guiding it is the barrier's job, not this.

[Elyri embodied action]

Load Frame Hold.name: Load Frame Hold
Load Frame Hold.description:
Enter a damaged structure and hold a load-bearing frame under its real structural load — a sagging ceiling, a cracked span, a shifting stack — for the whole span of a rescue or repair.

Master scope is bearing weight that is actually pressing: the frame matches the structure's load paths and takes the strain continuously while people work beneath it. The user stays within reach and does nothing else. A load beyond the core's support comes down through the frame, and every stretch of the hold advances fatigue and the overuse ladder. Not a permanent repair, not a lift and no substitute for an engineer's judgement on what happens when the hold ends.

[Elyri embodied action]

Sealed Refuge.name: Sealed Refuge
Sealed Refuge.description:
Enclose a group in a sealed hollow of organized energy that holds its own atmosphere against fire, flood, smoke, toxic vapour or a pressure breach for a bounded span.

Pinnacle scope is a complete envelope: closed on all sides, holding pressure difference and heat out while those inside breathe the air they arrived with. The user is inside and stationary for the whole hold, and the refuge ends when the user's core drops a rung, is struck hard or reaches the ladder's weakness stage. Air is not made; the refuge buys time, not survival. Nothing passes in or out while it is sealed, and it is not a vehicle or a weapon.

[Elyri embodied action]

Vessel Clamp.name: Vessel Clamp
Vessel Clamp.description:
Hold a single bleeding vessel, torn airway or leaking organ margin closed through core-mediated contact until conventional care can take over.

Practiced scope is one site, held: the contact stabilises what is under the hand and nothing else, and it lasts only while the hand stays there. It buys time; it does not repair, does not replace fluid the patient has already lost, and does not diagnose. A site the user cannot reach with contact is out of scope, and holding a patient of an unfamiliar species without medical knowledge of that body is guesswork that can do harm.

[Elyri embodied action]

Core Steadying.name: Core Steadying
Core Steadying.description:
Apply restorative contact to another Elyri's destabilised core, settling the early rungs of the overuse ladder — dimmed eyes, flicker, incipient weakness — so the patient stops sliding further.

Expert scope is the Elyri core itself as a treatable structure: the user reads the rung by contact and steadies it, which ordinary healing cannot. It works on the early ladder only; transparency, leakage and fracture are beyond it, and it never restores output already spent. The steadying draws on the user's own core, so the user's ladder moves while the patient's holds. Not a cure for repeated overuse and no permission to resume the work that dimmed them.

[Elyri embodied action]

Sustained Vigil.name: Sustained Vigil
Sustained Vigil.description:
Keep restorative contact on one critical patient continuously across hours — through transport, surgery or a night in the field — holding failing systems going.

Master scope is duration on a single patient: circulation, breathing and core support kept steady for as long as the user's own core holds out, with the user doing nothing else. The vigil is not treatment; the wound, poison or fracture remains and someone with the right skill must address it. Every stretch advances the user's fatigue and overuse ladder, and when the user's core falters the support ends at once. No confirmed-death reversal and no substitute for actual clinical care.

[Elyri embodied action]

Patterned Regrowth.name: Patterned Regrowth
Patterned Regrowth.description:
Guide the regrowth of a lost or destroyed living structure — a nerve, a section of limb, a portion of organ — from the patient's own remaining tissue pattern across repeated sessions.

Pinnacle scope is regrowth, not repair: the user reads what the body still carries of the missing structure and shapes new growth along it, session after session, with actual clinical knowledge of that species' anatomy. Progress is slow, each session costs the user a rung on the ladder, and the patient needs rest and care in between. What the body has no pattern for cannot be grown, and nothing here reverses a confirmed death, cures a fractured core or replaces a person.

[Elyri embodied action]

Settled Pocket.name: Settled Pocket
Settled Pocket.description:
Settle a small area of disturbed field around one workspace so that field-sensitive people and instruments inside it can work without the surrounding noise.

Practiced scope is a still pocket around the user, roughly the width of a working table, held while the user stays. It quiets ambient resonance; it does not stop an active working from entering, shield against attack or supply anything to anyone. Moving or being jostled breaks it, and a disturbance larger than the pocket simply overruns it. Conditions inside remain the actual conditions of the place, minus the noise.

[Elyri embodied action]

Steadied Ground.name: Steadied Ground
Steadied Ground.description:
Tune the domain so that another practitioner working inside it — a craft caster, an affinity user, a second Elyri — has stable field conditions to work against.

Expert scope is conditions offered to others: a steady field, damped interference, a predictable medium. It supplies no Vitality, no technique and no permission the practitioner does not already have; a working still costs its caster what it costs, and an affinity stays inside its own medium. The user must keep the domain while the other works and cannot use a demanding expression of their own meanwhile. Not a shield, not an amplifier and not imposed on an unwilling party.

[Elyri embodied action]

Marching Resonance.name: Marching Resonance
Marching Resonance.description:
Carry the domain with a moving group — on foot, by vehicle or in flight — across changing terrain and field, adjusting conditions as the environment shifts around it.

Master scope is a domain that travels: the user keeps it organized while moving, re-tunes it when the group passes through built structure, open ground or disturbed field, and holds it for hours rather than minutes. The domain is smaller and simpler than a stationary one, and every re-tuning costs stability. Losing the group or being struck hard drops it; so does the user's own exhaustion, which mounts continuously. Not a barrier, and no control over anyone the domain covers.

[Elyri embodied action]

Contested Ground.name: Contested Ground
Contested Ground.description:
Hold your domain against another active domain, a large hostile working or a natural field surge, negotiating the overlap so that your conditions stand where they are needed.

Pinnacle scope is contest: two organized fields pressing on each other, the user choosing where to concede and where to hold. Neither domain erases the other or its holder's agency; the boundary sits where the stronger organization is, and it moves. Holding against a larger opponent drains fast and drives the ladder; the user cannot attack or fly while contesting. Not suppression of another practitioner, not seizure of their working, and no automatic superiority over the craft.

[Elyri embodied action]

Safe Unthreading.name: Safe Unthreading
Safe Unthreading.description:
Loosen an exposed working instead of breaking it, so it fails slowly and bleeds off its stored energy rather than releasing it all at once.

Practiced scope is one small working, degraded gradually, from within reach: a lock, a lamp, a minor barrier. The user reads which strand carries the charge and lets it down gently, leaving a working that fades rather than one that snaps. It cannot stop a working that is already discharging, cannot touch a large installation, and does not sever affinity or embodied effects at all. A misread strand releases what it held, which is the hazard the unthreading exists to avoid.

[Elyri embodied action]

Standing Cut.name: Standing Cut
Standing Cut.description:
Hold a severance as a persistent line or plane in the field that active workings cannot cross for as long as the user maintains it.

Expert scope is a break that lasts: a held cut between a working and its intended reach, so that a projected effect stops at the line and a sustained connection cannot pass it. The line is fixed where the user places it and needs continuous attention; it fails when the user moves far, is struck hard or tires. It does not stop bodies, projectiles, heat or sound, and does not sever a working already on the near side. Strong or layered workings press against it and can push through if the user's core cannot match them.

[Elyri embodied action]

Nested Teardown.name: Nested Teardown
Nested Teardown.description:
Work down through the nested, layered workings of a large inscribed installation — seal on ward on binding — over an extended session, dismantling each layer in safe order without triggering what the layers hold.

Master scope is method across hours: reading dependency between layers, severing the outermost first, resting while the core recovers a rung, and stopping when the next layer's hazard is beyond containment. The user cannot fight or protect anyone while dismantling, and a layer misjudged releases what it contained. Not a machine shutdown, not erasure of anyone's affinity, and no way past a working whose stored energy has nowhere safe to go.

[Elyri embodied action]

Field Quarantine.name: Field Quarantine
Field Quarantine.description:
Isolate a bounded section of field so that no working inside it connects to anything outside and nothing outside reaches in — containing a runaway working or a failing installation long enough for others to evacuate or intervene.

Pinnacle scope is severance at area scale: a closed boundary rather than a line, around a space the user can perceive in full. Nothing inside is disrupted, only cut off. Holding against a large or hostile working drains fast and drives the ladder, and the user cannot act inside the boundary while holding. It does not stop bodies, air or heat, shut down machines, or sever affinity or another Elyri's embodiment.

[Elyri embodied action]

Working Handoff.name: Working Handoff
Working Handoff.description:
Pass a sustained embodied expression — a held platform, a mantle, a steadied field — to a willing trained Elyri without dropping it, so one can rest while the other carries on.

Practiced scope is the handoff of a single expression between two people, both in contact and both trained in what is being passed. The receiver must already have the technique; concord does not teach it. A handoff under attack or with a receiver whose core is already dimmed is likely to fail, and a failed handoff drops the expression entirely. No merged selves, no shared memories, and no handoff to an unwilling or untrained partner.

[Elyri embodied action]

Spaced Relay.name: Spaced Relay
Spaced Relay.description:
Chain concord through several willing trained Elyri spaced apart so that one expression — a platform, a domain, a field of protection — spans the distance between them.

Expert scope is reach across a line of contributors, each holding their segment and matched to their neighbours. Every contributor must have the technique for the shared expression and enough core to hold their part; the relay is only as strong as its weakest link and fails there. Contributors beyond each other's field reach drop out. The relay adds up to no more than the contributors put in, cannot include unwilling or untrained people, and shares no thought or memory along the chain.

[Elyri embodied action]

Rotation Hold.name: Rotation Hold
Rotation Hold.description:
Coordinate willing trained Elyri so that contributors cycle in and out of one long shared expression without breaking it, holding it far beyond what any single core's ladder allows.

Master scope is duration through rotation: the user holds the expression steady while each contributor enters, takes load and withdraws to recover, calling the rotation by reading each core's rung. The coordinator's own ladder advances throughout. The group cannot hold anything stronger than its strongest member could start, a contributor who hides their rung endangers everyone, and it all fails when the coordinator falters. No one is compelled to stay in the rotation.

[Elyri embodied action]

Borne Overflow.name: Borne Overflow
Borne Overflow.description:
Take a willing concord partner's overuse onto your own core, so that the partner stops sliding down the overuse ladder while you pay the cost in their place.

Pinnacle scope is transfer of cost, not removal: the partner holds at their current rung and every rung they would have lost lands on the user instead. One partner at a time, in contact, consenting, and only while the user's own core has room to take it. A user already deep on the ladder cannot bear more, and a mistake fractures two cores rather than one. It does not restore what the partner already spent, does not reverse fracture, leakage or transparency, and brings no one back from death.

[Elyri embodied action]

Passenger Carry.name: Passenger Carry
Passenger Carry.description:
Carry one cooperating passenger — or an equivalent held load — through a short local flight with a secure grip, a balanced lift, a stable transit and a landing both can walk away from.

Practiced scope is a single passenger who can hold on and follow instructions, over a distance the carrier can complete without a rest. Load, stamina and airspace set the ceiling; a passenger heavier than the carrier can lift safely is not carried. An unconscious or struggling passenger, a second passenger or bad weather is beyond this refinement. Flight itself is ordinary Starian biology; this is handling, not a new power.

[species baseline refined by training]

Dense Lane Threading.name: Dense Lane Threading
Dense Lane Threading.description:
Fly Nexara's crowded air lanes at traffic speed — between towers, through stacked transit levels, past other fliers and vehicles — reading gusts, wakes and blind corners as a trained lane flier does.

Expert scope is tight clearance in shared air: matching the lane's flow, holding position in tower crosswinds, threading gaps that open for a moment and giving way correctly. It is judgement and handling, not right of way; lane rules, other fliers' mistakes and actual visibility all still apply, and a collision at lane speed injures. Foul weather grounds a lane flier like anyone else once it exceeds what the body can handle.

[species baseline refined by training]

Long Haul Pacing.name: Long Haul Pacing
Long Haul Pacing.description:
Plan and fly a long-haul crossing — hours aloft, across weather fronts, with a load — pacing effort, altitude and rest so the flier arrives with enough left to land and act.

Master scope is endurance flight as a discipline: reading a front before entering it, choosing altitude for wind, setting rest stops, managing water and food, and turning back when the plan no longer holds. It does not extend the body's actual range, make weather safe or allow flight through conditions that would ground any Starian. Carrying a load or passenger shortens every leg. Fatigue on a long haul is real and can end a flight short of its destination.

[species baseline refined by training]

Rehearsed Routine.name: Rehearsed Routine
Rehearsed Routine.description:
Drill a procedure in advance — a boarding sequence, a medical protocol, a fire drill, a negotiation script — so that it executes cleanly under stress when the moment comes.

Practiced scope is preparation, the human answer to having no species power: the routine must actually have been rehearsed in play or in the character's stated background, and it covers only what was rehearsed. Novel conditions outside the routine break it. Executing well still resolves against the actual skill the routine uses; this is composure for a known task, not a shortcut past training.

[species baseline refined by training]

Coalition Footing.name: Coalition Footing
Coalition Footing.description:
Organise a mixed-species group so that each member's actual capability — flight, affinity, embodiment, hardware, craft — is placed where it counts, with the human translating between working conventions and covering the gaps.

Expert scope is coordination without a power of one's own: the human holds the plan, tracks who can do what, and adjusts as conditions change. It requires actual communication with each member; it grants no authority over them and no ability to use their capabilities. The plan is only as good as what the members honestly report, and a coalition under fire still needs each member to succeed at their own task.

[species baseline refined by training]

Improvised Countermeasure.name: Improvised Countermeasure
Improvised Countermeasure.description:
Assemble a working answer to an unfamiliar capability — an affinity expression, a craft working, a hostile drone, a species advantage — from preparation, observation and whatever is to hand, while the situation is still moving.

Master scope is adaptation under pressure: the human reads how the capability behaves, recalls what preparation covered, and improvises a countermeasure from learned craft, tools and allies. The countermeasure is only as good as the observation behind it and the materials available; it fails against a capability the human has misread. It confers no power, no immunity and no knowledge the human never had; it is the practised habit of turning what is known into something usable.

[species baseline refined by training]

Partition Listening.name: Partition Listening
Partition Listening.description:
Listen through a wall, floor, door or hull plate and pick out voices, footsteps or machinery on the far side within what Kharai hearing actually carries through the material.

Practiced scope is one partition and a still listener: the sounds must reach the ear through the structure, so thick, dense or noisy partitions defeat it, and a sealed hull may pass nothing. Words come through where the material and distance allow; tone and count of speakers come through more easily. Sudden loud noise against the partition overloads an ear pressed to it, and the listener hears nothing else while focused.

[species baseline refined by training]

Reflected Sound Mapping.name: Reflected Sound Mapping
Reflected Sound Mapping.description:
Build a working map of an unlit or smoke-filled space from reflected sound — your own footfalls, a tapped wall, a click of the tongue — reading walls, openings, drops and large objects from their echoes.

Expert scope is a new use of Kharai hearing: navigation by reflection where sight fails. The map is coarse, resolving surfaces and gaps rather than detail, and it needs a quiet enough space for the reflections to be heard; running machinery, wind or a crowd swamps it. Soft, cluttered or absorbent surfaces vanish from the map. Producing and listening for reflections while moving is tiring and overloads quickly in a loud environment.

[species baseline refined by training]

Signature Listening.name: Signature Listening
Signature Listening.description:
Identify the acoustic signature of an active working, an affinity in use or running field hardware — the hum, click and pressure change each produces — and tell one from another by ear.

Master scope is hearing what field activity does to the air and to structure: the Kharai learns the sounds of specific workings and specific practitioners as one learns voices, and can tell that a working is active, roughly where, and whether it is one heard before. It is not field perception; a silent working, a sealed room or a working that moves no air is not heard. Loud environments swamp it, sustained listening at this resolution is exhausting, and the ear gives no information about what a working will do next.

[species baseline refined by training]

Blind Handwork.name: Blind Handwork
Blind Handwork.description:
Perform fine manual work by touch alone — inside a housing, under a panel, in darkness or smoke — reading parts, fasteners and connections through the fingers.

Practiced scope is hands without eyes: the Rivani identifies and manipulates what the fingers can actually reach and distinguish, on a task the character already knows how to do. Unknown mechanisms are still unknown; touch gives shape, not understanding. Sharp edges, heat and live current injure the hands doing the reading, and light-frame strength still limits what can be forced or lifted while working blind.

[species baseline refined by training]

Live Mechanism Work.name: Live Mechanism Work
Live Mechanism Work.description:
Work on a running mechanism, an energised system or a moving patient with the hands timed to its motion — adjusting, clearing, stitching or reconnecting without stopping it.

Expert scope is fine handling against a moving target: the Rivani reads the rhythm of the mechanism or body and places each action in the gap. It needs the actual craft or medical skill for the task and a rhythm regular enough to read; an erratic or too-fast motion is not workable. Moving parts crush and cut light frames as readily as heavy ones, and the Rivani cannot brace against a mechanism's force, only avoid it.

[species baseline refined by training]

Inspection-Grade Handwork.name: Inspection-Grade Handwork
Inspection-Grade Handwork.description:
Assemble, repair or adjust at the smallest scale the hands can reach, meeting inspection-grade tolerance repeatedly across a long working session — a full run of identical connections, a complete re-seat of a fine mechanism, a long closure of delicate tissue.

Master scope is consistency at the limit of precision: the hands hold the same standard from the first action to the last, and the Rivani knows when steadiness has slipped and stops before an error. It does not shrink the task, supply the knowledge to judge what tolerance is needed, or make the hands stronger. Fatigue, cold, injury and tremor end a session early, and a light frame still cannot hold a heavy assembly steady while working on it.

[species baseline refined by training]

Braced Limb.name: Braced Limb
Braced Limb.description:
Thicken and stiffen one limb or body region — drawing mass from elsewhere in the body — to take a load, absorb a blow or wedge a gap for as long as the brace is needed.

Practiced scope is one region at a time within conserved mass: the braced limb gains what the rest of the body gives up, so the Olyth is thinner and weaker elsewhere while it holds. It does not add mass, copy another species' bone or make the body immune; a blow beyond the brace still injures. Holding a brace tires quickly, and the body needs recovery before another extensive reshaping.

[species baseline refined by training]

Formed Tool Limb.name: Formed Tool Limb
Formed Tool Limb.description:
Shape a hand or limb into a working form — a hook, a wedge, a broad paddle, a flat seal, a narrow probe — and hold it for a task that ordinary hands cannot do.

Expert scope is a functional shape held under use: the formed limb keeps its shape against the resistance of the task, within the core pattern and conserved mass. It does not become harder than Olyth tissue is, cut like a blade, or work as a tool the Olyth does not know how to use. Extended holding, temperature, chemicals and abrasion damage the formed limb as they would any tissue, and every long hold demands fatigue recovery before the next.

[species baseline refined by training]

Breach Seal Hold.name: Breach Seal Hold
Breach Seal Hold.description:
Spread and hold the body across a breach, hatch, pipe or crack to seal it against pressure, water, gas or smoke until it can be closed properly.

Master scope is a living seal under pain: the Olyth flattens within conserved mass to cover the opening, holds against the pressure difference, and endures the cold, heat, chemical contact and crushing that the seal takes. Pressure beyond what the body can hold tears the seal and injures the Olyth. The hold is a race against fatigue and exposure; recovery afterward is mandatory and slow, and repeated seals without rest damage the core pattern.

[species baseline refined by training]

Bypass Splice.name: Bypass Splice
Bypass Splice.description:
Bridge a damaged circuit, cut line or failed junction with carried parts and a handheld interface so that a system runs again on a temporary path.

Practiced scope is field repair by hardware: the Zencadian needs physical access, the right connector or conductor and a tester in hand. The splice carries what the parts can carry and fails under load they were not rated for; it is not a permanent repair. Nothing here is innate — without tools and parts there is no splice — and encrypted, sealed or unfamiliar hardware still resists a Zencadian as it would anyone.

[species baseline refined by training]

Tethered Drone Reach.name: Tethered Drone Reach
Tethered Drone Reach.description:
Fly a paired drone through a hand or wrist interface into a space you cannot enter — a flooded compartment, a hot duct, a live cable tray — to inspect, retrieve or manipulate through its tools.

Expert scope is remote hands via hardware: the Zencadian pilots the drone by its actual feed and controls, working within the drone's battery, tether, reach and tool set. Signal loss, jamming, damage or a space smaller than the drone ends the reach. The interface is a device the Zencadian carries and maintains, not a sense; take the drone away and there is nothing. Skilled piloting does not make the drone stronger than it is.

[species baseline refined by training]

Implant Handshake.name: Implant Handshake
Implant Handshake.description:
Bring a worn or implanted interface into handshake with an unfamiliar local system and hold real-time control of several devices at once — doors, lifts, drones, sensors — through it.

Master scope is multi-device control through implanted hardware: the interface negotiates protocols, holds sessions and presents the devices as one working set. It requires the implant to be fitted and powered, a physical or authorised link to the system, and credentials the security accepts; hostile security, air-gapped hardware and architectures the implant does not speak stay closed. Holding many sessions strains the operator's attention and the implant's capacity, and nothing works with the hardware removed.

[species baseline refined by training]

Ladder Reading.name: Ladder Reading
Ladder Reading.description:
Read where another Elyri stands on the overuse ladder — dimmed eyes, flicker, weakness, the first transparency — by sight and field sense, and read your own state honestly.

Practiced scope is diagnosis by Elyri biology: the reading is of visible and field-sensed signs, so a cloaked or distant Elyri cannot be read, and it tells the rung, not the cause. It grants no treatment and no ability to steady anyone. Reading your own rung is easier than admitting it; the ability gives the truth, not the will to stop.

[species baseline refined by training]

Signature Recall.name: Signature Recall
Signature Recall.description:
Learn the field signature of a specific practitioner, working or installation through contact, and recognise it again later — in a crowd, behind a wall, in the residue a working left.

Expert scope is memory of resonance: the Elyri holds a signature as one holds a face or a voice, and matches it when it is encountered again within field-sense range. It does not locate a signature at will, read intent, or identify a practitioner never met before. Similar practitioners from the same training blur together, residue fades, and a signature deliberately masked by a skilled practitioner may not match.

[species baseline refined by training]

Contained Core.name: Contained Core
Contained Core.description:
Damp your own field deliberately under provocation, attack or grief so that embodied output stays contained and the overuse ladder does not advance on an impulse.

Master scope is restraint as a physical discipline: the Elyri holds the core steady where instinct would flare, keeps output at what the moment actually needs, and stays at the current rung through pressure that would drop a less trained Elyri. It does not undo damage already taken, add stability the core lacks, or make an Elyri harder to hurt. A body already at weakness or transparency cannot contain what it no longer holds. Choosing not to flare is a choice each time; nothing here removes provocation or the cost of answering it.

[species baseline refined by training]

Moving Lightcast.name: Moving Lightcast
Moving Lightcast.description:
Keep a channelled working light lit while walking, climbing or working with both hands, and shape it into a narrow cone or a soft floor wash as the task needs.

What grew is composure: the light no longer drops when attention moves to footing or tools, and it can be angled without a free hand. It is still one light, held by active channelling and paid in Vitality as fatigue for as long as it burns; it goes out when the practitioner is struck hard, loses consciousness or steps into a thin field. No flash, no signalling at distance, no light left behind when the practitioner leaves.

[learned external magic]

Zoned Lightfield.name: Zoned Lightfield
Zoned Lightfield.description:
Fill a whole enclosed space, a hall, a yard or a loading floor, with even working light divided into zones the practitioner brightens, dims or colours independently, and pin one zone to a moving person or vehicle.

Sustained channelling now carries several lights as one working, so a search line, a surgery and a signal at the door are lit at once. The cost climbs with every zone and the size of the space, moving quickly from fatigue into strain; holding it through a fight or an injury shortens the working to minutes. Light cannot pass walls, project images or blind on its own; a thin field shrinks what the effort covers.

[learned external magic]

Inscribed Glowline.name: Inscribed Glowline
Inscribed Glowline.description:
Inscribe a line of light-marks onto walls, posts or a corridor floor that stay lit without the practitioner present, with a coded pulse pattern any companion can trigger by touch.

The debt is banked at making and grows with the length of the line and the brightness set into it; the marks then run on their inscription, fading over weeks and faster in weather or a thin field until renewed. The inscriber can set a night-only cycle, a dim standby and a full-bright alarm pattern. Marks cannot move, cannot follow a target, cannot be re-lit from a distance once dead, and are scraped away like any inscription.

[learned external magic]

Horizon Flare Call.name: Horizon Flare Call
Horizon Flare Call.description:
Invoke a prepared light working from a carried token to throw a single coded signal into the sky bright enough to be read from across a district or by craft in flight, or to drop a blinding sheet of light over an open area at will.

Invocation fires the banked working instantly, even with the practitioner wounded or mid-fall, because the cost was paid at making; each token holds one call and is spent. The signal's duration and pattern are set at the moment of use rather than at inscription. The flare does not aim, burn or hide the sender, and in a thin field its reach collapses to a rooftop's worth. No token, no call.

[learned external magic]

Exposure Warming.name: Exposure Warming
Exposure Warming.description:
Channel gentle heat into a living person's clothing, gloves and exposed skin against cold exposure, or thaw a frozen catch, hinge or valve without scorching it.

The practitioner now works on living subjects and on delicate mechanisms, holding a warmth the body tolerates rather than a workpiece temperature. Heat is steady, not fast: it treats chill, not deep hypothermia, and cannot be sustained on more than one person without the cost climbing into strain. No open flame, no cooling, no heating of a target the practitioner cannot touch or stand beside. Every minute of warmth is paid as Vitality fatigue.

[learned external magic]

Heat Drawdown.name: Heat Drawdown
Heat Drawdown.description:
Draw heat out of a volume rather than into it, chilling a room, freezing a puddle into footing or pulling the heat from a small fire until it dies, and dump that heat into a sink the practitioner names, such as a stone floor or open water.

Cooling is the new application: earlier stages only add heat. The sink is real and must be reachable; a bad sink scalds the practitioner's own hands or cooks the surroundings. Volume and speed set the price, and a fire the size of a burning vehicle is the edge of what one practitioner can pull before strain becomes injury. No weather, no frost at range, no freezing of a living body.

[learned external magic]

Banked Heat Panel.name: Banked Heat Panel
Banked Heat Panel.description:
Inscribe a panel, plate or lined chamber that holds a set temperature for days without attention, as a cold store, a warm shelter, a curing oven or an incubator, with the entire cost banked at making.

The working keeps its set point through ordinary day and night swings and shows, by a visible mark, when its bank is nearly spent. Larger chambers, wider gaps between the set point and the outside air, and thin fields all drain the bank faster; an opened door drains it fastest. The panel is fragile to cracking and scraping, cannot chase a moving target, cannot exceed the heat of a kitchen oven and never becomes a weapon.

[learned external magic]

Firebreak Invocation.name: Firebreak Invocation
Firebreak Invocation.description:
Invoke a prepared thermal working to strip the heat from a spreading fire along a building-width front, or to raise a wall of heat that seals a breach against passage, in the moment it is needed.

Prepared and banked in advance, the working can be called while burned, exhausted or carrying a casualty. The front holds for the minutes needed to move people, not for a night; a fire it does not fully kill will return. A heat wall stops crossing by making the crossing unbearable, not by a barrier, and can be endured or rushed. Each prepared front is spent on use, and in a thin field it covers a doorway rather than a street.

[learned external magic]

Carried Lift.name: Carried Lift
Carried Lift.description:
Lift a loose object no heavier than the practitioner could raise by hand and carry it along beside them while they walk, or catch something falling within reach before it lands.

The push has become a hold: the working now tracks the practitioner's own movement instead of staying where it was cast. It still needs sight of the load, still fails against anything anchored, held or resisting, and drops the load the instant channelling breaks. Vitality fatigue accrues by the minute of carrying and faster for the catch. No throwing, no shaping into a barrier, no lifting of a person.

[learned external magic]

Paired Vector Hold.name: Paired Vector Hold
Paired Vector Hold.description:
Hold two separate force vectors at once, bracing a door shut with one while dragging a person clear with the other, or steadying a swinging load from both ends.

Expert channelling divides attention without losing either line, and either hold can be released or reversed independently. Each vector is weaker than a single press of the same effort, and the pair costs more than one working of the same size, pushing quickly into strain if either target resists. Both targets must stay in view; neither can be flung, crushed or lifted clear of the ground. In a thin field only one line holds reliably.

[learned external magic]

Inscribed Load Brace.name: Inscribed Load Brace
Inscribed Load Brace.description:
Inscribe a standing force working into a structure, a prop under a sagging beam, a rail that guides cargo along a track or a bumper across a loading edge, that holds its load for days without the practitioner present.

The whole cost is banked at making and scaled to the load: a shoring brace for a passage costs a night's recovery, while a brace for a collapsing roof costs enough to injure. The brace holds a fixed geometry against a steady load and fails, sometimes suddenly, against shock, fire or a scraped inscription; the mark should be checked daily. It cannot move, cannot push, and cannot be re-aimed once set.

[learned external magic]

Falling Mass Catch.name: Falling Mass Catch
Falling Mass Catch.description:
Invoke a prepared force working from a token to arrest a falling or sliding mass, a dropped vehicle, a collapsing walkway or a slab, for the seconds needed to get people out from under it.

Because the work was made and paid in advance, the catch fires the moment it is invoked, even from a practitioner already hurt. The catch is a held pause, not a lift: the mass comes down again when the banked charge runs out, and the practitioner must call the moment of release. A mass beyond the token's making simply is not caught. One token, one catch; in a thin field the pause is a breath, not a rescue.

[learned external magic]

Threshold Line.name: Threshold Line
Threshold Line.description:
Lay a doorway-wide ward along a threshold or window frame against one named threat, tuned so that companions the practitioner names at inscription pass without triggering it.

The practitioner now works a whole opening instead of a patch, and carries pre-inscribed line tokens so a threshold can be laid in minutes rather than an hour. The ward decays over days, faster in weather and thin fields, and a break anywhere on the line drops the whole opening. It stops or warns of one kind of threat only, cannot judge intent, cannot hold a room, and is undone by scraping.

[learned external magic]

Travelling Shield Mark.name: Travelling Shield Mark
Travelling Shield Mark.description:
Inscribe a ward into a thing that moves, a vehicle's hull, a stretcher or the lining of a coat, so the protection travels with its bearer instead of staying on a fixed surface.

Expert inscription binds the ward to the object's own material rather than to a place, which is what earlier tiers cannot do. The mark protects against the few threats it was written for, wears with the object, and fails outright if the material is torn through or the field thins along the road. The bearer gains no judgement from it, cannot renew it themselves, and cannot make it cover others walking beside them.

[learned external magic]

Perimeter Lattice.name: Perimeter Lattice
Perimeter Lattice.description:
Inscribe a ring of linked wards around a compound or vessel that share their load, so a breach at one segment draws strength from the others and the inscriber knows which segment gave way.

The lattice carries a keyed pass-list the inscriber can amend without relaying the ring; a fault at any segment reports to a mark inside. Its making, banked in stages, costs enough Vitality to lay the inscriber up for days, and it needs a steady field: a thin patch anywhere on the ring becomes the weak segment. It cannot follow a moving line or know friends it was not told about, and any one segment can still be cut through given time.

[learned external magic]

Token Bulwark.name: Token Bulwark
Token Bulwark.description:
Invoke a full room-scale or body-close ward from a prepared token in the middle of an attack, with no inscription time, against the threats written into the token.

The making was paid in advance, so the ward rises in a moment even for a practitioner who is wounded, held or falling. It lasts as long as its bank, which the practitioner set at making; a large room lasts breaths, a single body lasts longer. A token cannot be re-aimed to a threat it was not written for, cannot be shared between two rooms, and is spent on use. In a thin field a token may sputter and give a fraction of what was banked.

[learned external magic]

Limb Cinch.name: Limb Cinch
Limb Cinch.description:
Cinch a binding around the limbs of a living subject who is thrashing, panicked or lightly resisting, an injured person or a frightened animal, or lock an object such as a door, a wheel or a lever in place.

Working on the living is what grew; the practitioner holds only what a strong pair of hands could hold, and holds it only while channelling. Determined resistance breaks it, and the cost rises with every moment of struggle. It restrains bodies, never intentions: a bound person can still speak, think and shout. No binding at range, no multiple subjects, no hold left running after the practitioner walks away.

[learned external magic]

Anchored Tether.name: Anchored Tether
Anchored Tether.description:
Bind a subject to a fixed anchor point so they can move freely within a set reach but cannot pass beyond it, or fix a moving vehicle to its berth so it cannot pull away.

The reach is set at casting and the tether holds as long as the practitioner channels or, with a prepared anchor mark, for hours after. A subject who reaches the edge is stopped, not hurt; a subject with cutting tools or an affinity that acts on the anchor can work free in time. The tether restrains bodies and objects only; it does not silence, does not compel, and cannot be moved once set. Thin fields shorten the reach.

[learned external magic]

Standing Hold Cell.name: Standing Hold Cell
Standing Hold Cell.description:
Inscribe a standing containment into a room, cell or hold that keeps a subject restrained for days without the practitioner present, with an inscribed pass for food, water and a physician.

The debt is banked at making and scaled to what the cell must hold, and the inscriber can also set it to immobilise a machine or a vehicle rather than a person. The cell grows no stronger than it was made and weakens as its inscription ages; a determined subject with time and tools, or an affinity the cell was not written against, will get out. It holds bodies, never minds, and cannot be made to punish, question or watch.

[learned external magic]

Group Snap Lock.name: Group Snap Lock
Group Snap Lock.description:
Invoke a prepared binding from a token to restrain every person the practitioner can see in a single room or yard at once, holding them in place for the minutes the token was made to hold.

The making was paid in advance, so the lock fires instantly and while the practitioner is under attack; releasing one subject or all of them is a spoken choice. Every subject caught adds to the drain on the bank, so a crowd is held for breaths where a handful is held for minutes, and anyone out of sight or behind cover is not caught. The lock restrains bodies only, never speech or intent; one token, one lock, and none in a thin field.

[learned external magic]

Signature Match.name: Signature Match
Signature Match.description:
Compare an exposed working to one the practitioner has handled before and tell whether it is the same maker's hand, the same method or the same discipline.

The practitioner now reads a working against memory instead of only for presence and pattern, which lets a fresh inscription be tied to a known one. The match is only as good as the remembered reference and says nothing about who a maker is, where they are or why they worked. Reading costs Vitality fatigue and needs the working within reach; it does not see through walls, cannot judge intent and cannot date a working beyond fresh or old.

[learned external magic]

Layer Separation.name: Layer Separation
Layer Separation.description:
Separate stacked or overlapping workings in a dense place, such as a warded, sealed and route-marked doorway, and read each one in turn without disturbing the others.

Expert channelling holds the survey steady long enough to peel the layers apart, where earlier survey saw only a blur. Each layer read is paid for separately, so a many-layered site pushes the practitioner from fatigue into strain, and a layer that is dormant or made to hide stays hidden until it acts. The practitioner still needs to be present and undisturbed; nothing is seen at distance or into the past.

[learned external magic]

Sentinel Inscription.name: Sentinel Inscription
Sentinel Inscription.description:
Inscribe a standing detector on a threshold, corridor or vault that records the discipline and rough strength of every working that passes or acts nearby, for the inscriber to read back later.

The record is written into the mark itself and costs its bank at making; a busy doorway fills the mark in days, a quiet vault in weeks. The sentinel notes workings, not people: it cannot name a passer, cannot record speech, and does not sound an alarm unless paired with a ward. It is scraped away like any inscription and reads nothing in a thin field; a working made to pass detectors may pass it.

[learned external magic]

Block Sweep Invocation.name: Block Sweep Invocation
Block Sweep Invocation.description:
Invoke a prepared survey working across a whole building or city block, sorting every active working found by discipline and strength into a single readable map the practitioner holds in mind for the following hour.

The sweep is paid at making and released in a moment, so it can be run from a doorway under fire. It shows what is active at the moment of the sweep and nothing that is dormant, shielded or older than its residue; dense or thin fields leave blind patches the practitioner should assume are there. The map fades and cannot be redrawn without a new sweep, names no person and reveals no thought.

[learned external magic]

Cargo Cold Mark.name: Cargo Cold Mark
Cargo Cold Mark.description:
Mark a container so that harvested goods, medicines or a tissue sample inside it stay fresh through a day's transport under the conditions written into the mark.

What grew is the mark's tolerance for movement, jolting and changes of air on the road, where a keeping seal needs settled storage. The bank is paid at making and drains faster in heat, in sun and in thin fields, and the mark shows a visible fade as it nears the end. It does not clean, cool or sterilise, does not make unknown goods safe, and cannot keep anything living.

[learned external magic]

Tissue Arrest.name: Tissue Arrest
Tissue Arrest.description:
Arrest deterioration in living tissue that is no longer supported, a severed limb, an organ for transport or a body for return to family, so that it reaches a physician or a home unchanged.

Expert inscription is what allows the working to hold biological material without cooking or drying it. The subject is held, not healed, and not revived: what was dead stays dead, and what was severed is not reattached by this. The hold lasts hours to days according to the bank and the field, and the practitioner is charged deep enough to strain for anything larger than a limb. No arrest of a living, breathing person.

[learned external magic]

Vault Conditioning.name: Vault Conditioning
Vault Conditioning.description:
Condition an entire storeroom, vault or hold against decay, damp, heat and pests, with a reference mark by the door that shows how much of the working's bank remains.

The debt is banked in stages over days of inscription and scaled to the room, and the working then runs for a season without the practitioner unless the field thins or the door is left open. It slows decay for known compatible goods across the whole space rather than sealing each item, but it does not clean what came in dirty, does not sterilise, and cannot hold living tissue or a person. Damage to the walls breaks the conditioning.

[learned external magic]

Breach Hold Invocation.name: Breach Hold Invocation
Breach Hold Invocation.description:
Invoke a prepared preservation working to freeze the deterioration of a failing structure, a cracked beam, a corroding hull plate or a flooding tunnel wall, long enough for a repair crew to reach it.

Paid at making and fired in a moment, the hold stops the crack widening and the corrosion spreading for the hours the token was banked to cover; it does not mend, lift or reinforce, and the load that caused the failure is still there. The practitioner must touch or stand on the structure to invoke it, one token per span. A thin field or a fresh impact can break the hold early, and nothing living is held.

[learned external magic]

Bleed Clamp.name: Bleed Clamp
Bleed Clamp.description:
Hold a reachable wound closed and slow its bleeding while another pair of hands dresses it, and ease the patient's pain enough for them to be moved.

The practitioner now treats an actual injury rather than only supporting a patient, and can keep the clamp while walking beside a stretcher. It holds one wound at a time, needs touch, and costs Vitality by the minute; a wound that needs surgery still needs surgery. No pain removed altogether, no internal bleeding reached, no restarting of a heart that has stopped.

[learned external magic]

Toxin Slowing.name: Toxin Slowing
Toxin Slowing.description:
Slow the spread of venom, poison or infection through a patient and keep their breathing and circulation supported for the hours it takes to reach an antidote or a clinic, alternating between two patients when needed.

Expert channelling holds a working inside a moving body over hours rather than minutes, which is the new capacity. The toxin is slowed, not removed, and the working buys time against a known agent; an unknown agent is a guess. Tending two patients splits attention, and the cost runs into strain within hours. The working cannot revive, cannot cure and cannot be handed to another practitioner.

[learned external magic]

Convalescent Inscription.name: Convalescent Inscription
Convalescent Inscription.description:
Inscribe a bed, cot or small ward-room so that several patients' natural recovery is supported for days without the practitioner present, banked at making.

The inscription steadies breathing, sleep and wound healing for compatible species within its bounds, and shows by a visible mark when its bank is low. It cannot perform surgery, cannot replace nursing, and helps recovery already under way rather than arresting a crisis; a patient who worsens needs a physician. Every additional bed and every day banked draws on the inscriber's Vitality, and the room fails if the field thins.

[learned external magic]

Triage Invocation.name: Triage Invocation
Triage Invocation.description:
Invoke a prepared healing working across a whole casualty group at a disaster site, stabilising everyone within reach at once for the minutes needed to sort and move them.

The work is paid at making so it fires in a moment even while the practitioner is injured, but the bank spreads across every casualty caught, so many bodies get a hold of breaths where a few get minutes. It stops bleeding, steadies breathing and holds shock at bay; it does not mend, does not treat toxins, and never restarts a stopped heart or returns the dead. One token, one site, no second call without a fresh token.

[learned external magic]

Return Trace.name: Return Trace
Return Trace.description:
Set a mark at a spot and later invoke it from anywhere within the same district to feel the direction back to it as a steady pull.

What grew is the mark's readability at distance: earlier marks are read only where they stand. The pull is direction only, not distance, and offers no route around walls, water or hostile ground; it fades over days and dies in a thin field. The practitioner must have set the mark in person, can hold only one live mark at a time, and gains no speed from it.

[learned external magic]

Steady Passage.name: Steady Passage
Steady Passage.description:
Inscribe a stretch of floor, stair, ladder or ledge so that anyone reading the mark keeps their footing and climbs or descends with less effort than the ground would normally allow.

Movement assistance is now written into a place rather than only pointing the way; the assistance is real and enough that a loaded stretcher team can take a slope they could not otherwise. The mark serves one span, wears with feet and weather, and is paid at making by its length. It does not lift, does not carry, does not help anyone who cannot see it, and offers nothing on ground that gives way.

[learned external magic]

Cargo Glide Line.name: Cargo Glide Line
Cargo Glide Line.description:
Inscribe a line along a fixed corridor, a dock, a mine drift or a warehouse aisle, along which heavy loads slide on their own skids or pallets with a fraction of the usual effort, for days.

The debt is banked at making and grows with length and the loads the line is made to bear; a crew can then move in a day what would take a week. The line runs one way at a time as set, cannot lift a load off the ground, cannot turn a corner it was not laid around, and is scored, scraped and wet-fouled like any inscription. It moves objects, not people, and a thin field leaves dead stretches.

[learned external magic]

Evacuation Invocation.name: Evacuation Invocation
Evacuation Invocation.description:
Invoke a prepared route working so that every mark in a network the practitioner laid lights at once and points toward the nearest safe exit, with movement assistance along each marked span for everyone reading it.

Paid at making, the invocation runs the whole network from one token even with the practitioner injured or cut off from most of it. It points only along marks already laid and knows nothing of an exit that has since collapsed; the practitioner should choose the exits before the emergency, not during it. The assistance lasts for the minutes banked, moves no one who cannot walk, and a thin field leaves marks dark.

[learned external magic]

Maker Stamp.name: Maker Stamp
Maker Stamp.description:
Set a personal authentication feature into the practitioner's own workings at making, and renew a fading known working the practitioner has inspected against a reference.

Signing and renewal are what grew; a seal check only reads. The stamp identifies the practitioner's hand to a later inspector and is as forgeable as any craft mark to someone who has studied it long enough. Renewal costs Vitality and materials each time and only restores what the working was; it cannot upgrade, cannot certify another's work, and cannot vouch for a working the practitioner has not examined.

[learned external magic]

Tamper Ledger.name: Tamper Ledger
Tamper Ledger.description:
Inscribe a keyed feature onto a working so it records each attempt to read, alter or break it, which the practitioner can read back as a sequence of touches with a rough time and method.

Expert inscription writes memory into a mark, where earlier stages only verify. The ledger notes that a touch happened and how, not who; it names no one and sees no face. It fills after a handful of entries, must be read in person, and can itself be broken by a practitioner who knows it is there. The making is banked and modest, but a ledger set on another's working needs their consent or leaves evidence of trespass.

[learned external magic]

Custody Chain.name: Custody Chain
Custody Chain.description:
Inscribe an authentication that passes along a chain of holders, so each hand-off must be countersigned with the receiver's own stamp and a broken or skipped link shows to any later inspection.

The chain lets an object, a sealed record or a cargo be trusted across many hands and days without the practitioner present, banked at making and priced by its links. It proves that a chain was followed or not; it does not prove the object inside was honest to begin with, and a forger holding every holder's stamp could still pass it. Each link needs a practitioner who can countersign, and a thin field can leave a link blank.

[learned external magic]

Revocation Invocation.name: Revocation Invocation
Revocation Invocation.description:
Invoke a prepared master key to void every authentication the practitioner issued within one system at once, or to lock a compromised working so that no stamp, including their own, will open it until re-issued.

Paid at making and fired in a moment, the revocation reaches every mark the key was written across, wherever it is; it is the answer to a stolen stamp or a broken chain. It voids only the practitioner's own issuance, cannot revoke another's, and cannot repair or re-issue what it locks; re-issue is done by hand, one working at a time. One key, one system, and in a thin field some marks may not hear it.

[learned external magic]

Style Recognition.name: Style Recognition
Style Recognition.description:
After a few exchanges with an opponent, name the school, curriculum or House tradition they fight in and adjust to its known habits and weak points.

The read is drawn from actual observation of movement and comes with real knowledge of the style, so an unfamiliar or mixed style yields only a partial read. It tells the practitioner how the opponent was trained, not what they will do next, and gives nothing against an opponent who has not yet committed to an exchange.

[practiced advantage, not a new power sys]

Tempo Reset.name: Tempo Reset
Tempo Reset.description:
Break contact mid-fight and re-enter on terms of the practitioner's choosing, a new distance, new footing or a new weapon hand, so the engagement restarts at their tempo rather than the opponent's.

The reset works only where there is space to break and the opponent cannot simply pursue; it costs the ground given up and any advantage already held. It changes who sets the pace of the next exchange, not its outcome, and an opponent who has read the reset coming denies it.

[practiced advantage, not a new power sys]

Threshold Expression.name: Threshold Expression
Threshold Expression.description:
Express a personal affinity at the lowest intensity it can hold, enough to act but too faint for most onlookers or a casual sensing to notice.

Refinement here is restraint: the practitioner keeps the expression inside its own medium at a whisper for as long as concentration lasts. The effect is correspondingly small, and a trained sensor, close attention or a strong field response can still catch it. Nothing new is expressed; the expression is quieter, not different, and holding a whisper under provocation is its own strain.

[practiced advantage, not a new power sys]

Split Expression.name: Split Expression
Split Expression.description:
Hold one affinity expression on two separate targets or points at once, steadying two falling loads, warming two hands or lighting two marks, each at reduced strength.

The practitioner's medium does not change and no second expression appears; it is the same expression divided, and the division divides attention as well as effect. Either half fails the moment the practitioner is struck or startled, and the strain of the split is felt as fatigue and feedback in the body, not as a magical cost. No stacking with any other ability's effect.

[practiced advantage, not a new power sys]

Absence Reading.name: Absence Reading
Absence Reading.description:
Determine from a set of records what has been removed, altered or never filed by reading the shape of the gaps against the record-keeping practice of the office that made them.

The reading needs enough of the surrounding record to know what should be there, and produces a description of the gap, a missing quarter, an out-of-sequence entry or a re-copied page, not its contents. It cannot say who made the gap or recover what was taken, and a record keeper who knew the practice well can hide a gap from it.

[practiced advantage, not a new power sys]

Record Lineage.name: Record Lineage
Record Lineage.description:
Reconstruct the custody history of a document, object or claim through cross-referenced archives, producing a lineage that a House court or registry accepts as a serious finding.

The lineage is only as complete as the surviving records, and the practitioner must have actual access to them; sealed or destroyed archives leave honest gaps that the finding states. It establishes where a thing has been and in whose hands, not whether it is what it claims to be, and cannot be produced faster than the archives can be read.

[practiced advantage, not a new power sys]

Crowd Halt.name: Crowd Halt
Crowd Halt.description:
Stop a moving crowd or the front of a mob with voice and bearing alone, buying a pause in which others can act.

The halt holds only as long as the practitioner keeps the crowd's attention and gives it somewhere to look; it does not disperse, persuade or command, and a crowd already fighting or already fleeing does not stop. It works on people who can see and hear the practitioner and who have some reason to hesitate; it does nothing to someone who has already decided.

[practiced advantage, not a new power sys]

Weapons Down.name: Weapons Down
Weapons Down.description:
Bring an armed and hostile party to lower their weapons and hear the practitioner out, through demonstrated composure and a credible offer, before anyone commits to violence.

The lowering is a pause, not a surrender: the weapons stay in hand, and the offer must be real. It fails against a party under orders to fight, a party that has already been fired on, or anyone who cannot see the practitioner's face. No deception, no compulsion, and nothing that holds once the offer is refused.

[practiced advantage, not a new power sys]

Steady Under Fire.name: Steady Under Fire
Steady Under Fire.description:
Perform a delicate task, dressing a wound, reading a working or threading a cable, while under direct attack, without the panic penalty the scene would normally impose.

Composure removes the fear cost, not the danger: the task still takes its time and the practitioner still takes what hits them. It covers one task at a time and requires that the practitioner can see where the fire is coming from; a surprise from behind still lands. Nothing is done faster, only done properly.

[practiced advantage, not a new power sys]

Line Steadying.name: Line Steadying
Line Steadying.description:
Hold a line of companions steady under fire by visible composure and clear, short orders, so that no one in sight of the practitioner breaks or freezes.

The steadying reaches people who can see the practitioner and who already trust them; strangers and panicked civilians are not held by it. It keeps a line from breaking, not from being beaten, and ends the moment the practitioner goes down or is seen to run. Orders are heard, not obeyed automatically.

[practiced advantage, not a new power sys]

Background Channel.name: Background Channel
Background Channel.description:
Carry an active working into the background of attention, keeping it alive while walking, talking or fighting instead of standing still over it.

The working continues at reduced precision and full Vitality cost; the practitioner still pays in fatigue and strain for every minute, and a hard blow or a stumble breaks it. One working only, and never one that needs aiming or a steady hand. This makes a caster mobile, not stronger, and grants nothing to prepared work.

[practiced advantage, not a new power sys]

Ladder Sense.name: Ladder Sense
Ladder Sense.description:
Know precisely where the practitioner's own Vitality sits on the fatigue, strain, injury and overdraft ladder during a working, and stop at a chosen line without overshooting into the next stage.

The sense is of the practitioner's own body only and gives no reading of another caster. It prevents accidental overdraft, not chosen overdraft: a practitioner who decides to cross into injury still pays injury. In a thin field the ladder climbs faster than it feels, and the sense reports the climb but cannot slow it.

[practiced advantage, not a new power sys]

Abandon Call.name: Abandon Call
Abandon Call.description:
Decide in moments what to let go, a position, a load, a plan or a person who cannot be reached, and state it so plainly that a team stops arguing and moves.

The call is a decision under uncertainty, not foresight; it may be wrong, and the practitioner owns it. It works on a team that accepts the practitioner's lead and does nothing for a group that does not. What is abandoned is genuinely abandoned; the ability does not make a way back.

[practiced advantage, not a new power sys]

Cascade Cut.name: Cascade Cut
Cascade Cut.description:
In a failing operation, identify the single decision that stops one failure from becoming the next and make it before the cascade runs, sealing a hatch, halting a convoy or ordering a retreat.

The cut depends on information the practitioner actually has; a hidden cause stays hidden and the wrong cut makes things worse. It stops the spread of failure, not the first failure itself, and requires people or systems that will act on the order at once. No prophecy, no reading of what has not yet happened.

[practiced advantage, not a new power sys]

Feint Discard.name: Feint Discard
Feint Discard.description:
Recognise a feint as it begins and decline to answer it, holding guard for the true attack behind it.

The discard is a read of weight, hips and eyes, and works against fighters whose feints the practitioner has seen or whose style is known; a genuinely novel deception still draws the guard. It does not block the true attack by itself, only keeps the guard where it should be, and a feint that turns into a real strike is met as a real strike.

[practiced advantage, not a new power sys]

Opening Read.name: Opening Read
Opening Read.description:
Read where the next committed attack will land from an opponent's set-up and have the guard, angle or step already there when it arrives.

The read is of one opponent in view and lasts one exchange; a second attacker or a thrown weapon from outside the read is not covered. It positions the defence, it does not make it succeed: a stronger or faster attacker still gets through a well-placed guard. It fails against attacks with no set-up, such as a shove from a crowd.

[practiced advantage, not a new power sys]

Graceful Withdrawal.name: Graceful Withdrawal
Graceful Withdrawal.description:
Give a hostile or humiliated party a way to leave a confrontation with their standing intact, so that they take it instead of escalating.

The exit must be real, a concession, a delay or a face-saving form of words, and the practitioner must be able to deliver it. It ends a confrontation, not a dispute; the underlying quarrel remains for another day. It does nothing for a party who wants the fight, and it cannot be offered by someone who has just insulted them.

[practiced advantage, not a new power sys]

Standing Table.name: Standing Table
Standing Table.description:
Keep talks open between parties who would rather fight, becoming the accepted channel through which each side speaks to the other when they will not speak directly.

The practitioner's standing depends on visible fairness to both; one side's advantage taken openly ends it. It keeps messages moving and meetings possible, not agreement; either party can walk away, and the practitioner carries their words rather than shaping their minds. No secrecy is guaranteed against a party that chooses to leak.

[practiced advantage, not a new power sys]

Casualty Sorting.name: Casualty Sorting
Casualty Sorting.description:
Sort a group of casualties by survivability and urgency in the minutes after an incident, marking who is treated first, who can wait and who cannot be saved with what is present.

The sorting is a judgement from visible signs and quick checks, not a diagnosis; hidden injuries are missed and a call can be wrong. It organises care, it does not deliver it, and the practitioner must state the resources the sorting assumes. It never declares a living patient dead; it names who will not be reached in time.

[practiced advantage, not a new power sys]

Long Carry Care.name: Long Carry Care
Long Carry Care.description:
Keep a critically injured patient alive through hours of transport over bad ground with only carried supplies, re-checking and re-dressing as conditions change.

The practitioner buys the patient the journey, not a cure; some injuries kill on the road regardless and the practitioner knows which. It covers one critical patient at a time and requires the practitioner to stay with them; a second critical patient splits the care. No surgery in transit, no blood that is not carried, no resurrection.

[practiced advantage, not a new power sys]

Long Pace.name: Long Pace
Long Pace.description:
Set and hold a travelling pace for hours that untrained companions cannot match, over road, stair or broken ground, while still able to speak, navigate and fight at the end of it.

The pace is the body's, sustained by conditioning and fed by food, water and eventual rest; it does not lift others to it, and a companion who falls behind is behind. Injury, altitude and cold cut it short honestly. It spends reserves that repay in recovery time, not for free.

[practiced advantage, not a new power sys]

Sleepless March.name: Sleepless March
Sleepless March.description:
Function through a full day and night and into the following day without sleep, moving, working and making decisions, before the body finally forces rest.

Judgement slips before the body fails, and the practitioner should know that their own reads become unreliable toward the end. The march does not remove the need for sleep; it defers it, and the debt is paid in a long recovery afterward. A wound, cold or hunger shortens it, and nothing carried on the march is carried for free.

[practiced advantage, not a new power sys]

Bearing Sense.name: Bearing Sense
Bearing Sense.description:
Sense the direction and rough distance to an active working that is out of sight, behind a wall, on another floor or along a street, well enough to walk to it.

The sense finds workings that are active now, not residue or dormant inscriptions, and gives no information about the working beyond that it is there and roughly how strong. Several workings in one direction blur together, and a shielded working or a thin field hides it. This finds a working, not a caster.

[practiced advantage, not a new power sys]

Thin Field Warning.name: Thin Field Warning
Thin Field Warning.description:
Read the local field's thickness and its shifts moment to moment, and give companions clear warning before a working is attempted in a place where the price would be higher than expected.

The read is of the field itself and gives the practitioner a real basis to say that a working here will cost more or fail; it does not lower the cost or thicken the field. It covers the ground the practitioner can walk in a few minutes and is only as current as the last read; fields shift. It grants no sight of workings, casters or intentions.

[practiced advantage, not a new power sys]

Paired Cover.name: Paired Cover
Paired Cover.description:
Fight back to back or shoulder to shoulder with one chosen companion so that each covers the other's blind side, and neither is flanked while the pair holds.

The pairing needs a companion who accepts it and who can keep up; it is a shared discipline, not a shield around them. It removes the flank from a pair, not the front, and breaks the moment either is pulled away or knocked down. It coordinates two people, not a squad.

[practiced advantage, not a new power sys]

Melee Herding.name: Melee Herding
Melee Herding.description:
Steer a group melee's flow by movement and positioning, drawing attackers into each other's way, onto bad footing or across a companion's line, so that numbers count for less.

Herding works on attackers who are moving and reacting, not on a disciplined formation that holds its ground, and the practitioner must have room to move. It shapes where a fight happens, not how it ends; attackers who are herded still attack, and the practitioner's own footing is at risk in the steering. Nothing about it controls anyone.

[practiced advantage, not a new power sys]

Protocol Access.name: Protocol Access
Protocol Access.description:
Use the correct forms, introductions and timing of a House to gain an audience, entry or a hearing that a stranger would be refused.

The access is what protocol grants: a door opened, a hearing given, a message received; not agreement, not trust. It works in Houses whose forms the practitioner actually knows, and a House that has closed its doors on purpose is not opened by manners. A misstep in front of the wrong person costs the access it gained.

[practiced advantage, not a new power sys]

Neutral Carrier.name: Neutral Carrier
Neutral Carrier.description:
Carry messages and offers between Houses as a recognised neutral, accepted by each side as a channel that will not be shot at, searched or detained while carrying.

The standing is earned in play and lost in a moment by visible partiality or a leaked message; it protects the carrier while carrying, not their friends or their politics. Houses that recognise no neutral are not bound, and a carrier can still be refused. The message is delivered as given, not improved.

[practiced advantage, not a new power sys]

Account Reconciliation.name: Account Reconciliation
Account Reconciliation.description:
Reconcile contradictory witness accounts of the same event, separating honest error from deliberate falsehood by where and how the accounts fail to fit the physical evidence.

The method finds inconsistency, not thoughts: it shows which account cannot be true as told and why, and leaves motive to be established. It needs the accounts and the evidence in hand, and a liar who has seen the evidence can fit their story to it. No reading of faces, no compulsion, no certainty where the evidence is thin.

[practiced advantage, not a new power sys]

Cold Trail Revival.name: Cold Trail Revival
Cold Trail Revival.description:
Reopen a stalled or abandoned investigation and find the thread the original work missed, the witness never asked, the record never pulled or the assumption never tested.

The revival is a methodical re-walk of the case as it was worked, and yields a next step, not an answer; the thread may lead nowhere. It requires the original file and access to what remains of the scene, witnesses and records, and cannot recover what time destroyed. No omniscience: what was never recorded and no one remembers stays lost.

[practiced advantage, not a new power sys]

Cover and Angle.name: Cover and Angle
Cover and Angle.description:
Cover head and body with your forearms while stepping off the attacker's line, so a committed strike lands on your guard or on empty air instead of on you.

This works against one attacker at a time for a single exchange and keeps your footing and an exit in view; it does not produce a counter, and it only reduces what a weapon or a much stronger opponent does rather than stopping it. If you cannot see the strike coming there is nothing to cover.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Crowded Room Pivot.name: Crowded Room Pivot
Crowded Room Pivot.description:
Defend against two or three unarmed attackers in a confined space by pivoting and backing so that they obstruct one another and only one can reach you at any moment.

The scope grew from one attacker to a small group, and it works while you retreat towards a door or wall you have already picked.
