Trade blows from the rooted stance with one opponent who comes to you, answering each strike from position. It does nothing against someone who will not engage, and staying rooted means staying reachable.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Refuse the Push.name: Refuse the Push
Refuse the Push.description:
Take one shove, charge or throw attempt and stay where you stood. The force is still felt, and a large enough force still moves you.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Losing Correctly.name: Losing Correctly
Losing Correctly.description:
Concede an exchange or a bout in the Orvantis way: yield what is already lost while keeping footing, guard and standing, so the loss costs no more than it must. It is a way to lose well, not a way to win.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Unmoved Root.name: Unmoved Root
Unmoved Root.description:
Hold ground against sustained pressure from one opponent so that nothing they do moves you from the spot. This is body and training, not an affinity; the root holds while stamina does.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Old Form Mastery.name: Old Form Mastery
Old Form Mastery.description:
Fight in the complete Old Forms, meeting every approach from a root that cannot be hurried and turning each attacker's commitment into a trade on your ground. This is the Orvantis tradition and may be named as such. A mobile opponent who never commits can still leave it waiting.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Measured Exchange.name: Measured Exchange
Measured Exchange.description: Open with a controlled probing exchange to learn how one opponent answers pressure. Starting trained action only. Resolve against the actual scene and relevant skills; no bonus stacking, new power, item or automatic success.

Probe and Record.name: Probe and Record
Probe and Record.description:
Spend the first exchanges of a fight testing one opponent's guard, reach and timing, and carry what you learned into the next exchange. It learns only what the opponent actually shows.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Correction.name: Correction
Correction.description:
After losing an exchange, adjust the one thing that lost it before the next. It fixes a mistake; it does not guarantee the next exchange.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Method Review.name: Method Review
Method Review.description:
Against an opponent you have fought or studied before, begin the fight already adjusted to what they did last time. If they have changed since, the review works against you.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Model the Opponent.name: Model the Opponent
Model the Opponent.description:
Build a working model of one opponent's pattern mid-fight and fight to it, closing the options they rely on. A truly unpredictable opponent breaks the model.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Outdated Data.name: Outdated Data
Outdated Data.description:
Fight a known opponent from the record so completely that every habit they carry becomes a liability. This is the Zelvaris Method at its height and may be named as such. The same weakness runs both ways: anyone who knows your record can do it to you.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Draw What Works.name: Draw What Works
Draw What Works.description: Choose between the weapon you actually carry for range and the one for close work, and use the right one for the distance in front of you. Starting trained action only. Resolve against the actual scene and relevant skills; no bonus stacking, new power, item or automatic success.

Distance Then Close.name: Distance Then Close
Distance Then Close.description:
Hold one opponent at range with a carried firearm, then switch to a carried blade as they close, without a gap in between. Both weapons must actually be on you, and the switch still takes a heartbeat.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Quiet Blade.name: Quiet Blade
Quiet Blade.description:
End a close encounter with a carried blade instead of a shot, when noise would bring more trouble. It trades range and safety for silence.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Hold the Perimeter.name: Hold the Perimeter
Hold the Perimeter.description:
Take a covered position on a perimeter and keep one approach closed against people coming at it. It covers one approach, from real cover, with real ammunition.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

People Behind You.name: People Behind You
People Behind You.description:
Fight a small group while keeping the civilians behind you out of their reach, choosing every shot and cut by where those people stand. It protects by position, not by magic; a threat you cannot see gets through.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Whole Kit.name: Whole Kit
Whole Kit.description:
Fight with everything you carry as one system: firearm, blade, cover and armor chosen for the fight in front of you, switching without hesitation. This is the Sol frontier practice at its height and may be named as such. It is only as good as the kit actually on you.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Instrument Guard.name: Instrument Guard
Instrument Guard.description: Deflect an attack while keeping a held tool, device or instrument safe and working. Starting trained action only. Resolve against the actual scene and relevant skills; no bonus stacking, new power, item or automatic success.

Ward Protocol.name: Ward Protocol
Ward Protocol.description:
Put yourself and any drone you actually control between a threat and the person or equipment you are protecting, preferring restraint to injury. It protects; it does not win the fight.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Tool Transition.name: Tool Transition
Tool Transition.description:
Turn the tool already in your hand into a guard or a strike without dropping it or losing your place in the work.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Fallback Protocol.name: Fallback Protocol
Fallback Protocol.description:
When communication fails, act on the protocol you and your allies agreed in advance, so they know exactly where you are and what you will do. It needs a real, prior agreement.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Aegis Spacing.name: Aegis Spacing
Aegis Spacing.description:
Keep yourself, your allies and any drones you control at formation spacing so no attacker can isolate one of you. One unit is vulnerable; the spacing is the defense.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Formation Is the System.name: Formation Is the System
Formation Is the System.description:
Run your owned drones and trained allies as one defensive formation, each covering another, so the whole holds where any single part would fail. This is Contair doctrine and may be named as such. It needs the actual drones and people; without them there is only your own guard.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Patient Guard.name: Patient Guard
Patient Guard.description: Hold a tight guard and absorb pressure without committing, waiting for an opening. Starting trained action only. Resolve against the actual scene and relevant skills; no bonus stacking, new power, item or automatic success.

Let Them Spend.name: Let Them Spend
Let Them Spend.description:
Absorb one opponent's committed attack sequence until they overextend, then answer once. It costs you every blow you absorb along the way.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Know the Terms.name: Know the Terms
Know the Terms.description:
Before an arranged bout, learn its exact rules and stopping conditions, and fight precisely within them. It applies only to agreed bouts with stated terms.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Attrition Stance.name: Attrition Stance
Attrition Stance.description:
Hold a defensive stance through a long exchange so the opponent tires before you do. Stamina decides it, and a stronger opponent can simply break the guard.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Technically Permitted.name: Technically Permitted
Technically Permitted.description:
In an arranged bout, turn the rules themselves into your advantage: ring, time and stoppage conditions used exactly as written. It never breaks a rule, and a judge can still rule against you.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

The Long Game.name: The Long Game
The Long Game.description:
Win a fight on your own timeline: absorb, wait, let the rules and the clock work, and finish only when the opponent has spent themselves. This is the Caelthorn stance at its height and may be named as such. An opponent who never overextends turns it into a draw.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Clinical Weave.name: Clinical Weave
Clinical Weave.description: Slip an attack with minimal movement while staying calm enough to keep working. Starting trained action only. Resolve against the actual scene and relevant skills; no bonus stacking, new power, item or automatic success.

Reach the Wounded.name: Reach the Wounded
Reach the Wounded.description:
Move through an active fight to one injured person, avoiding the blows in between. It gets you there; it does not stop the fight.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Slip the Grab.name: Slip the Grab
Slip the Grab.description:
Break or avoid one attempt to seize or hold you. A strong enough grip still holds.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Weave and Stabilize.name: Weave and Stabilize
Weave and Stabilize.description:
Keep one injured person stable with your hands while evading the attacks that come at you both. Real treatment still needs real supplies and time.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Nobody Else Falls.name: Nobody Else Falls
Nobody Else Falls.description:
Read the fight around a casualty and keep moving between them and each new threat. It protects by position; a threat that gets past you still lands.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Triage Under Fire.name: Triage Under Fire
Triage Under Fire.description:
Move through a whole fight, triaging and stabilizing the wounded while nobody lands a clean blow on you. This is the Myralis weave at its height and may be named as such. It saves people, not the situation.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Partner Cover.name: Partner Cover
Partner Cover.description: Cover one willing partner's open side while they act. Starting trained action only. Resolve against the actual scene and relevant skills; no bonus stacking, new power, item or automatic success.

Call and Answer.name: Call and Answer
Call and Answer.description:
Coordinate one exchange with a partner through a spoken or signalled call, so you act together rather than separately. It needs a partner who knows the call.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Crowd Lane.name: Crowd Lane
Crowd Lane.description:
Open a path through a crowd for someone who needs to get through, without harming anyone in it.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Market Discipline.name: Market Discipline
Market Discipline.description:
Keep a small group together and moving through a busy, dangerous space. It keeps them together; it does not fight for them.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Chain of Hands.name: Chain of Hands
Chain of Hands.description:
Direct a small group of allies or civilians through a fight, each covering the next. It depends on their actual willingness and ability to follow.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Everyone Home.name: Everyone Home
Everyone Home.description:
Bring a whole group out of a fight together, no one left behind, the drill carrying them where no single fighter could. This is the cooperation drill at its height and may be named as such. It protects a group; it does not defeat an enemy.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Committed Blow.name: Committed Blow
Committed Blow.description: Put your whole weight behind one strike or one swing of a heavy weapon. Starting trained action only. Resolve against the actual scene and relevant skills; no bonus stacking, new power, item or automatic success.

Guard Crusher.name: Guard Crusher
Guard Crusher.description:
Drive one heavy blow through an opponent's guard by force. It breaks a guard, not an armored body, and a dodge makes it a wasted swing.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Heavy Swing.name: Heavy Swing
Heavy Swing.description:
Swing an actually held heavy weapon with control rather than momentum alone.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Showstopper.name: Showstopper
Showstopper.description:
Land one decisive blow in front of an audience at the moment it will be remembered. The blow is real; the crowd's reaction is its own thing.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Unreadable Windup.name: Unreadable Windup
Unreadable Windup.description:
Disguise a heavy blow so the opponent cannot read when or where it is coming. It hides the timing, not the commitment; a missed blow still leaves you open.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Impossible Finish.name: Impossible Finish
Impossible Finish.description:
End a fight you should have lost with one decisive blow into the opponent's one real weakness at the one moment it shows. This is power striking at its height and may be named as such. It needs a real weakness and a real moment; without them it is only a big swing.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Opening Move.name: Opening Move
Opening Move.description: Strike first from actual concealment before the target knows you are there. Starting trained action only. Resolve against the actual scene and relevant skills; no bonus stacking, new power, item or automatic success.

Wait for It.name: Wait for It
Wait for It.description:
Hold concealment until the one moment a target is least ready, then act. Patience can be spent; if the moment never comes, neither does the strike.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Quiet Approach.name: Quiet Approach
Quiet Approach.description:
Close on a target without being noticed across ground you can actually use.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Choose the Ground.name: Choose the Ground
Choose the Ground.description:
Pick and prepare the place where a fight will happen before it does. It needs time and access to the ground in advance.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Second Ambush.name: Second Ambush
Second Ambush.description:
Break contact in the middle of a fight and vanish into real cover, forcing the opponent to find you again. It needs cover to vanish into.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Never Where Expected.name: Never Where Expected
Never Where Expected.description:
Run a fight as a series of ambushes against several opponents, never where they expect you. This is the ambush practice at its height and may be named as such. In open ground with nowhere to hide, it is gone.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Answer Only.name: Answer Only
Answer Only.description: Meet an attack with a block and a single answering strike, never the first blow. Starting trained action only. Resolve against the actual scene and relevant skills; no bonus stacking, new power, item or automatic success.

Patient Counter.name: Patient Counter
Patient Counter.description:
Let one opponent attack until the pattern shows, then counter it cleanly. It waits for the opponent; if they never commit, it never answers.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Parry and Step.name: Parry and Step
Parry and Step.description:
Turn one attack aside and step to the side it leaves open.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Exact Answer.name: Exact Answer
Exact Answer.description:
Answer each attack with exactly as much force as it carried and no more. It keeps a fight from escalating; it does not end it by itself.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Nothing First.name: Nothing First
Nothing First.description:
Read an opponent's intent well enough to be ready for every attack they begin, countering each. It needs them to attack; it has no opening move of its own.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

End It Kindly.name: End It Kindly
End It Kindly.description:
Counter an attack into a hold or a fall that ends the fight without lasting harm. This is the counterstrike method at its height and may be named as such. A lethal or armed attacker still demands a harder answer.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Formation Step.name: Formation Step
Formation Step.description: Keep your place beside willing allies so that none of you is left exposed. Starting trained action only. Resolve against the actual scene and relevant skills; no bonus stacking, new power, item or automatic success.

Barrier Line.name: Barrier Line
Barrier Line.description:
Set an actually carried engineered barrier or shield beside an ally's so the two cover each other. It is equipment; it can fail, and it covers only the line it is set on.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Called Terms.name: Called Terms
Called Terms.description:
Call a halt and offer terms mid-fight, loudly and clearly enough that the other side has to answer. It creates a pause; it cannot force acceptance.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Proven Drill.name: Proven Drill
Proven Drill.description:
Run a practised drill with trained allies: advance, hold, rotate, withdraw. It needs allies who know the drill.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Coalition Line.name: Coalition Line
Coalition Line.description:
Build a working line out of mixed allies, whatever their species or training, assigning each the place that suits them. It depends on their willingness to follow.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Accord Formation.name: Accord Formation
Accord Formation.description:
Hold a disciplined formation through a whole engagement, barrier to barrier, rotating the tired and giving no one an opening. This is the Meridian drill at its height and may be named as such. It needs the equipment and the people; without them it is one fighter.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Measured Entry.name: Measured Entry
Measured Entry.description: Enter a doorway or confined space ready to meet whatever is inside. Starting trained action only. Resolve against the actual scene and relevant skills; no bonus stacking, new power, item or automatic success.

Augmented Breach.name: Augmented Breach
Augmented Breach.description:
Use augments you actually have to force a door, barrier or grip that would stop an unaugmented body. It is only as strong as the real augment, which can fail or overheat.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Within Tolerance.name: Within Tolerance
Within Tolerance.description:
Push your augments to their tested limit and no further, keeping them working through a fight. It avoids burnout; it adds no strength the augment lacks.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Room Entry.name: Room Entry
Room Entry.description:
Clear one room of immediate threats with trained allies, each taking a side. Bystanders and unknown exits remain real hazards.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Upgrade Read.name: Upgrade Read
Upgrade Read.description:
Read an opponent's visible augments and dated technology and fight to their weaknesses. It reads only what can be seen or known; hidden enhancements stay hidden.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Chosen Body.name: Chosen Body
Chosen Body.description:
Fight with everything your augmented body can actually do, at its limit and in full control. This is the Vanguard practice at its height and may be named as such. The body is what you made it, no more.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Lantern Salute.name: Lantern Salute
Lantern Salute.description: Open a duel with the formal lit signal and guard that declare a challenge. Starting trained action only. Resolve against the actual scene and relevant skills; no bonus stacking, new power, item or automatic success.

Warded Parry.name: Warded Parry
Warded Parry.description:
Turn a blow with a ward you inscribed in advance on your blade or guard. The ward was paid for when it was made, decays with use, and can be read or severed by another practitioner.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Signal Feint.name: Signal Feint
Signal Feint.description:
Flash a small inscribed light signal to draw one opponent's eye before the real cut. It costs vitality, and an opponent who knows the trick ignores it.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Inscribed Edge.name: Inscribed Edge
Inscribed Edge.description:
Fight with a blade carrying a prepared inscription for one clear effect you actually inscribed. It needs the preparation and the field; in a thin field it fades.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Read the Working.name: Read the Working
Read the Working.description:
Read an opposing practitioner's active workings mid-duel and fence around them. It reads workings, not minds.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Lantern Duel.name: Lantern Duel
Lantern Duel.description:
Fight a complete formal duel in the Lantern tradition, blade and prepared craft as one. This is Lantern signal fencing at its height and may be named as such. Its bill is paid in vitality, and a thin field leaves only the blade.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Whatever's Handy.name: Whatever's Handy
Whatever's Handy.description: Grab the nearest usable object and use it to strike or block. Starting trained action only. Resolve against the actual scene and relevant skills; no bonus stacking, new power, item or automatic success.

Cargo Cover.name: Cargo Cover
Cargo Cover.description:
Put crates, carts or freight between you and one opponent, then strike around it. It needs real clutter, and the cover can be knocked over.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Crowd Slip.name: Crowd Slip
Crowd Slip.description:
Slip through a crowd faster than a pursuer can follow. It depends on the crowd, which moves on its own.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Terminus Scrap.name: Terminus Scrap
Terminus Scrap.description:
Keep your footing and your head in a chaotic fight between several parties, hitting whoever is the real threat. It keeps you standing, not unhurt.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Read the Room.name: Read the Room
Read the Room.description:
Spot who in a fight is armed, who is watching and who will join in before they do. It reads what can be seen; a hidden watcher stays hidden.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Gatefall Rules.name: Gatefall Rules
Gatefall Rules.description:
Fight a whole crowded scrap on your terms, using every object, corner and bystander-free gap the place offers. This is dockside brawling at its height and may be named as such. On open, empty ground it has nothing to work with.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Balanced Base.name: Balanced Base
Balanced Base.description: Drop into a low, balanced stance that is hard to knock over. Starting trained action only. Resolve against the actual scene and relevant skills; no bonus stacking, new power, item or automatic success.

Heard Before Moving.name: Heard Before Moving
Heard Before Moving.description:
Listen to one opponent's footwork and breath to hear when they will move. It hears sound, not thoughts; in a loud place it fails and can overwhelm you.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Low Stance Slip.name: Low Stance Slip
Low Stance Slip.description:
Slip under one attack from the low stance, keeping balance.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Committed Rush.name: Committed Rush
Committed Rush.description:
Once you have committed, close on one opponent and take them into a grapple without hesitation. It commits completely; a wrong read cannot be taken back.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Clan-Web Hold.name: Clan-Web Hold
Clan-Web Hold.description:
Coordinate a hold with trained clanmates so one opponent is held from several sides. It needs the clanmates.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Binding Once Heard.name: Binding Once Heard
Binding Once Heard.description:
Take and hold an opponent so completely that the fight is over, without lasting harm. This is the Clanmoot rush at its height and may be named as such. A lethal attacker or a deafening place still changes everything.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Close Cut.name: Close Cut
Close Cut.description: Make one precise short-blade cut with fine control. Starting trained action only. Resolve against the actual scene and relevant skills; no bonus stacking, new power, item or automatic success.

Inside the Reach.name: Inside the Reach
Inside the Reach.description:
Slip inside a larger opponent's reach where their size works against them. Getting in is dangerous; one solid hit still costs a light frame dearly.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Compact Turn.name: Compact Turn
Compact Turn.description:
Turn and reposition in a tight space where a larger fighter cannot.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Lattice Movement.name: Lattice Movement
Lattice Movement.description:
Fight through dense, cluttered, many-levelled city space, using every ledge and gap. It needs a space built that way.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Fine Point.name: Fine Point
Fine Point.description:
Place a blade exactly where a strap, grip or joint gives way. Precision, not power; armor still stops it.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Fellowship Dance.name: Fellowship Dance
Fellowship Dance.description:
Fight in the full dance, precise and never where a larger opponent expects, or paired with a fellowship partner who knows the steps. This is the Rivani blade dance at its height and may be named as such. Reach and mass still belong to the other side.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Compress and Absorb.name: Compress and Absorb
Compress and Absorb.description: Compress to take the force of one blow across the body instead of at one point. Starting trained action only. Resolve against the actual scene and relevant skills; no bonus stacking, new power, item or automatic success.

Interlock Guard.name: Interlock Guard
Interlock Guard.description:
Interlock your guard with one consenting ally so each covers the other, without merging. It needs their consent and a planned position.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Reshape Around.name: Reshape Around
Reshape Around.description:
Reshape slightly to slip one grab or strike. Limited reshaping only; it costs hydration and recovery.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Planned Defense.name: Planned Defense
Planned Defense.description:
Fight a defense planned in advance for this place and these threats. It holds against what was planned for; the unplanned finds it slower.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

The Pattern Holds.name: The Pattern Holds
The Pattern Holds.description:
Keep your shape and dignity against an opponent trying to force contact or break your form. It resists; a strong enough force still harms.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Assembly Interlock.name: Assembly Interlock
Assembly Interlock.description:
Hold a planned interlocked defense with several consenting allies, each covering another. This is the interlock defense at its height and may be named as such. It never merges, and it does not improvise well.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Pre-Decided Answer.name: Pre-Decided Answer
Pre-Decided Answer.description: Act at once on the answer you decided in advance for exactly this kind of threat. Starting trained action only. Resolve against the actual scene and relevant skills; no bonus stacking, new power, item or automatic success.

Second Layer.name: Second Layer
Second Layer.description:
Fall back to the backup protection you actually carry when the first fails. Two layers, not invulnerability; both can still fail.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Structure Use.name: Structure Use
Structure Use.description:
Use corners, bulkheads, hatches and structure to set the range of a fight. It needs a built space.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Layered Defense.name: Layered Defense
Layered Defense.description:
Arrange your equipment, drones and position into several independent layers of defense. It needs the equipment and time to set it.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Threat Model.name: Threat Model
Threat Model.description:
Fight to a threat model built from what you know of this opponent and place. It is planning, not foresight; what you did not model surprises you.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Redundancy Is Morality.name: Redundancy Is Morality
Redundancy Is Morality.description:
Fight with every layer you carry, each covering the failure of another, so no single failure ends you. This is Zencadian hull combat at its height and may be named as such. Strip the equipment and a tall, clever, fragile person remains.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Field-Sense Step.name: Field-Sense Step
Field-Sense Step.description: Read a shift in the ambient field as a body moves, and step before the blow lands. Starting trained action only. Resolve against the actual scene and relevant skills; no bonus stacking, new power, item or automatic success.

Flowing Evasion.name: Flowing Evasion
Flowing Evasion.description:
Flow around one opponent's sequence of attacks through field-sense and movement. It reads the field, not intent; a still, patient opponent gives little to read.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Core Economy.name: Core Economy
Core Economy.description:
Fight without spending the core on anything that does not matter, keeping reserves for when it does.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Channel-Lit Counter.name: Channel-Lit Counter
Channel-Lit Counter.description:
Answer an attack with a counter carried by a brief, disciplined flare of embodiment. It drains the core, and the light shows.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

Blaze Drill.name: Blaze Drill
Blaze Drill.description:
Fight in the small, disciplined Blaze manner with trained companions, each covering another. It needs the companions and the discipline.

[trained action only; resolve against the actual scene]

The Channeled Storm.name: The Channeled Storm
The Channeled Storm.description:
Fight at the full intensity a being of living energy can sustain, flowing and answering without a wasted spark. This is responsive flow at its height and may be named as such. It spends the core fast; overuse fractures it.

Obsidian Redirection.name: Obsidian Redirection
Obsidian Redirection.description:
Yield ground to one charging opponent and turn their momentum into a fall, a stumble or a step into the line's guard, as Redline officers are drilled in the Inner Obsidian Yard. It takes the energy they bring; an opponent who does not commit gives it nothing to turn, and it is not Kaldor's Dominion Pressure.
